title: Electrical Engineer - Project Coordinator
description:
As a premier electrical contracting firm, we are looking for a versatile and driven **Electrical Engineer** to join our team. This role is a hybrid of technical design, project management, and strategic bidding. You won’t just be sitting behind a desk; you will be the bridge between complex electrical blueprints and successful project completion.



 Core Responsibilities 

* **Design & Drafting: : Develop comprehensive **shop drawings** and technical layouts using **AutoCAD** and **Bluebeam**.

* **Project Coordination: : Read and interpret electrical drawings to create detailed work schedules, ensuring labor and materials align with project milestones.

* **Estimating & Bidding: : Analyze project specifications to prepare accurate and competitive bids for upcoming contracts.

* **Technical Compliance: : Ensure all designs and installations adhere to safety standards and industry regulations.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration: : Act as the primary point of contact between the field crew, general contractors, and clients to ensure seamless project execution.



---



 **Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Technical Proficiency: : Advanced skills in **AutoCAD** and **Bluebeam** are required for drafting and document markup.

* **Blueprint Literacy: : Mastery in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, one-line diagrams, and architectural floor plans.

* **Regulatory Knowledge: : A strong familiarity with the **National Electrical Code (NEC)** is a significant advantage and will be prioritized.

* **Organizational Skills: : Proven ability to manage project timelines, coordinate resources, and meet strict deadlines.

* **Communication: : Strong verbal and written skills to effectively relay technical information to non-technical stakeholders.



---



 **What We Are Looking For**

* **The "Perpetual Student" Mindset: : In our industry, no two projects are the same. We need someone who is genuinely excited to learn new electrical concepts and emerging technologies every single day.

* **Problem Solvers: : You should be able to look at a complex electrical challenge and find a code-compliant, cost-effective solution.

* **Contracting Experience: : Previous experience working specifically within an electrical contracting environment is highly preferred.



---



 Why Join Us ?

We offer a fast-paced environment where your work has a direct impact on the skyline. You will gain hands-on experience in the full lifecycle of a project—from the first bid to the final inspection. If you are ready to grow your technical expertise while managing high-stakes projects, we want to hear from you.

title: Loan Underwriter & Account Manager | Full-time Remote
description:
Description:



We’re seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional to join our team as a Loan Underwriter & Account Manager. This role involves reviewing loan applications, assessing risk, and managing customer accounts. You will also handle inbound support calls, assisting borrowers and investors with inquiries related to loans and repayments.





Key Responsibilities:



Review and analyze loan applications, including credit reports, income verification, and financial history.

Assess risk and determine loan eligibility based on goPeer’s underwriting policies.

Monitor borrower accounts and manage communications regarding loan status, payments, and risk mitigation.

Handle inbound support calls, assisting borrowers and investors with inquiries.

Ensure compliance with lending regulations and internal underwriting standards.

Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to process improvements.





Requirements:



Experience in underwriting, lending, or financial services is required.

Strong analytical skills to assess creditworthiness and financial data.

Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

Experience in customer support, account management, or call handling is an asset.

Ability to work efficiently in a remote environment.

High degree of professionalism and capability to handle sensitive and confidential information.

Knowledge of credit risk assessment and financial analysis is a plus.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Availability to work 9 AM – 5 PM Eastern Time. This role follows a rotating schedule where workdays include weekends, and two days off are assigned during the week.

Your own work devices and setup (high-quality microphone and headset)

Good French verbal and written communication skills.

Knowledge of the Canadian Banking, Lending, or Investment industries.

If you’re interested in applying, please attach a link to your resume, highlighting your experience in underwriting, lending, or customer support, along with a short video introduction of yourself.

goPeer is Canada’s leading peer-to-peer lending platform, connecting everyday investors with borrowers. We provide fair and transparent loans while offering investors a unique opportunity to earn passive income. Apply today to join a supportive, innovative team environment with opportunities for professional growth.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist – Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO & AI Search (UK Home Services, Full-time)
description:
TYPE: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday to Friday. Flexible hours, with at least 3 hours' overlap with UK business hours (e.g. 4pm–7pm PH time).



SALARY: USD $900 to $1,500/month (PHP equivalent), based on proven results. Performance bonuses tied to cost per lead and booked jobs. Pay review after 3 months.



ABOUT US

Perenna Services is a home and property services company in Oxford, England, covering garden maintenance and landscaping, tree surgery, building and renovations, and waste removals. Our motto is "Live. Work. Grow." We're launching a new website and building a premium local brand across Oxfordshire and London.



THE ROLE

You'll own how Perenna Services wins customers online: paid advertising first, then search and AI search, then organic social. You'll work directly with the founder and alongside our part-time Video Editor & Content Creator, who produces your ad creatives.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (in order of priority)



1. Paid advertising (about 50% of your time)

Meta 
 & Instagram):

- Lead-generation campaigns: instant forms, click-to-WhatsApp / Messenger and landing-page conversion campaigns

- Advantage+ and manual campaigns, postcode geo-targeting (Oxfordshire and London boroughs), custom and lookalike audiences

- Retargeting website visitors, video viewers and past enquiries

- Weekly creative testing (hooks, formats, offers) with a clear test-and-kill routine

- Meta Pixel and Conversions API set up and maintained properly

Google:

- Search campaigns on high-intent keywords (e.g. "tree surgeon Oxford"), match types, negative keywords and ad assets

- Performance Max with lead and local goals

- Google Local Services Ads (Google Guaranteed): set-up, verification and disputing bad leads

- YouTube and Demand Gen video ads, plus Display remarketing

- Call tracking and offline conversion import from our CRM (HubSpot), so Google optimises for booked jobs, not clicks

Other channels and planning:

- Microsoft (Bing) Ads, Nextdoor Ads and TikTok Ads

- Seasonal campaigns (spring gardens, autumn clear-ups, storm-damage tree work)

- Budget pacing, bid strategies (target CPA, maximise conversions) and weekly optimisation



2. SEO and AI search (about 30%)

- Local SEO: Google Business Profile, citations and directories (Yell, Checkatrade, Bark, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect), review generation, and local landing pages for each town and service

- Technical SEO on WordPress: site speed, Core Web Vitals, schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ, Review), indexing via Search Console

- AI search optimisation (GEO / AEO): getting Perenna Services recommended in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot, through entity consistency, structured data, FAQ content and mentions on trusted sites

- 4 SEO articles a month (AI-assisted, human-edited) and landing-page conversion testing



3. Tracking and reporting (about 10%)

- GA4, Google Tag Manager and a Looker Studio dashboard

- Monthly report: spend, leads, cost per lead, booked jobs and cost per job by channel, plus rankings, reviews and AI-search visibility



4. Organic social and local growth (about 10%)

- Direct the content calendar with our video creator so organic and paid work together

- Local and guerrilla marketing ideas: door-drops near finished jobs, neighbour referral offers, van and site signage, community partnerships



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years running Meta Ads and Google Ads yourself (hands-on, not just reporting), ideally for local service businesses

- Proof of results: case studies or screenshots showing spend, cost per lead / CPA and outcomes

- Confident with GA4, Tag Manager, Pixel / Conversions API and conversion tracking

- Hands-on local SEO and Google Business Profile experience

- Strong written English, reliable internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE

- Google Ads and Meta certifications

- Local Services Ads, Microsoft Ads, Nextdoor or TikTok Ads experience

- Semrush / Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, Looker Studio

- HubSpot or GoHighLevel CRM, and call tracking (e.g. CallRail)

- UK, US or Australian home-services clients



HOW TO APPLY (takes 10 minutes)

Send a message with:

1. The subject line "Grow Perenna – Ads"

2. One ad campaign you ran yourself: platform, monthly spend, cost per lead and the result (a screenshot link is welcome)

3. In 3–5 lines: which 3 Google or Meta campaign types you'd launch first for a tree surgery and garden company in Oxford, and why

4. Your expected monthly salary



Shortlisted applicants get a 30-minute video call and a short paid test task.

Advanced AI Experience Is REQUIRED

We're searching for someone who has already cracked advanced AI video production and automation.

Claude Code and agentic AI workflows.

Generating realistic AI UGC and consistent AI characters.

Building systems that allow you to produce more ads with less manual work.



Combining multiple AI tools into one efficient production workflow.



We want someone who can show us actual systems they've built or currently use.

Supplements

Beauty



Problem-Solution Products

Your ability to produce high-quality AI creatives.

title: Senior Scheduling Coordinator, US Home Care: Own the Schedule (US Eastern Hours)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

You run the schedule. We don't want someone who waits to be told what to do.



We're a US home care company with 7 offices and about 500 caregivers, and we're growing fast. We need a senior scheduler who sees a gap at 6am, works the list, makes the decision, writes it down and tells the on-call manager what they did. We give you a clear process, good tools (WellSky, RingCentral) and a team that backs you. You bring judgment, speed and care with the details. We measure you on results: shifts covered, nothing missed, hours inside the authorization. Not on how often you ask permission.



This is a long-term role. As we add offices, the people who own their work here are the ones who lead the next team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own client schedules in WellSky against the plan of care, authorized hours and client preferences

- Fill call-offs and open shifts before they become missed visits, and fix next week's gaps early

- Rework schedules for hospital stays, discharges and hour changes, and tell caregivers and families what changed

- Match caregivers to clients by skills, availability, distance and fit

- Close the team's task queue (timesheets, care logs, coverage) the same day

- Keep scheduled hours inside payer authorizations so billing is clean

- Talk with caregivers, families and case managers by phone and text

- Take a turn on the after-hours on-call rotation



YOU ARE

- Decisive: you make the call and own the result

- Exact: one wrong time or a double booking bothers you, so you check

- Steady under pressure: three problems at once is a normal Tuesday

- A finisher: nothing you touch stays open overnight



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US scheduling in home care, home health or healthcare staffing (general call center or VA work does not count)

- Scheduling against payer authorizations (Medicaid waiver, VA, long-term care insurance)

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Full US Eastern business hours, 8:30am to 5:00pm ET (night shift in the Philippines)

- Stable internet, backup power or internet, a quiet private workspace and a headset



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- WellSky/ClearCare, AxisCare, AlayaCare, HHAeXchange or similar home care software

- RingCentral or a similar phone system



PAY AND BENEFITS

- $1,300 to $1,700 per month in USD, paid twice a month

- Raise review at 90 days, then yearly

- 13th month pay every December

- 10 paid days off per year

- 8 paid Philippine holidays: New Year's Day, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Labor Day, Independence Day, All Saints' Day, Christmas and Rizal Day. If you work one, you're paid double

- Company laptop: buy one locally and we reimburse up to $1,000

- Long-term, full-time role with a 90-day trial period

- A growth path: we're adding offices, and our best people lead what comes next



The selected candidate will sign a confidentiality agreement, since the role works with client health information.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed)

1. Complete our short Culture Index survey: 
/p/5RcDO6ETFnwN

2. Send a message with the word "HANDLED" as the first line and a short summary of your US home care or healthcare scheduling experience and the software you've used.

3. Attach or link a 1-2 minute voice recording. It's 6am, a caregiver just called off a 7am shift, and nobody on your list is free. Tell us exactly what you do, in order.

Finalists complete a short paid scheduling exercise and a video interview.

Open to new ideas and different approaches.

Professional and natural telephone manner.

Comfortable managing multiple leads and working inside a CRM.

REQUIREMENTS

Real estate wholesaling experience strongly preferred.

Previous CRM experience required.

Strong spoken English and communication skills.

Ability to consistently follow up and manage leads.

Strong work ethic, positive attitude, coachability, and adaptability.

HOW TO APPLY

TO BE CONSIDERED, YOU MUST SUBMIT BOTH OF THE FOLLOWING:



1. YOUR RESUME



Include your previous real estate experience, positions held, responsibilities, and accomplishments.



2. A 30–60 SECOND VOICE RECORDING



Record yourself speaking naturally so we can evaluate your spoken English, communication skills, and professionalism.

PLEASE ALSO INCLUDE:

Your experience qualifying motivated homeowners.

Which CRMs you’ve previously used.

Your previous responsibilities and accomplishments.

FINAL NOTE

We are looking for someone who brings experience to the table but doesn’t have an ego.



Someone who is confident, professional, hardworking, teachable, adaptable, and serious about improving.



Experience gets your foot in the door. Your attitude, work ethic, coachability, and performance will determine how far you go.



If this sounds like you, we want to hear from you!

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Expert
description:
About ERPS Group



ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies. We provide accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll, CFO advisory, and business consulting services to clients across multiple industries.

Our mission is to deliver exceptional client service while helping entrepreneurs make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term success. We believe in professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and teamwork. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating an outstanding client experience.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Full-Charge Bookkeeper who can independently manage the day-to-day bookkeeping operations of a U.S.-based company.

The ideal candidate is highly experienced with QuickBooks Online/Desktop (QBO, QBD) and understands bookkeeping from end to end — including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, invoicing, reconciliations, financial reporting, and month-end closing.

This is not a data-entry position. We need someone who understands why transactions are recorded a certain way, can identify discrepancies, and can maintain accurate and organized financial records with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



QuickBooks & Bookkeeping

 - Manage the company’s bookkeeping activities in QuickBooks.

 - Record and categorize daily financial transactions accurately.

 - Maintain the chart of accounts and ensure transactions are properly classified.

 - Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

 - Review accounts for discrepancies, duplicates, missing transactions, and unusual activity.

 - Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.



Accounts Payable

 - Manage vendor bills and accounts payable.

 - Enter, categorize, and track bills in QuickBooks.

 - Monitor outstanding payables and payment due dates.

 - Verify invoices and supporting documentation.

 - Maintain accurate vendor records.

 - Assist with payment processing and AP reporting.



Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

 - Create and send customer invoices.

 - Track outstanding invoices and accounts receivable.

 - Apply customer payments accurately.

 - Follow up on overdue invoices when required.

 - Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.

 - Maintain accurate customer records.



Month-End & Financial Reporting

 - Complete monthly bank, credit card, AP, and AR reconciliations.

 - Assist with month-end closing procedures.

 - Prepare and maintain monthly financial statements, including:

 - Profit & Loss

 - Balance Sheet

 - Accounts Receivable Aging

 - Accounts Payable Aging

 - Cash flow reports

 - Identify unusual fluctuations and communicate potential issues to management.

 - Provide clean and accurate financial information for management and tax/accounting purposes.



Requirements



3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, preferably supporting U.S.-based businesses.

Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks Online/Desktop.

Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and accounting principles.

Strong experience with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

Proven experience with invoicing and payment tracking.

Strong bank and credit card reconciliation experience.

Experience with month-end closing and financial reporting.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to identify errors and discrepancies rather than simply entering data.

Excellent English written communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office setup.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with U.S. companies and U.S. accounting practices.

Experience with service-based businesses.

Experience working with multiple entities or businesses.

Familiarity with payroll transactions and payroll reconciliations.

Familiarity with sales tax accounting.

Experience working alongside CPAs, tax preparers, or CFOs.

QuickBooks Online certification is a plus.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:

Detail-oriented — small discrepancies do not get overlooked.

Proactive — you identify problems before they become bigger problems.

Accountable — you take ownership of your work and deadlines.

Organized — financial records are clean, structured, and easy to understand.

Analytical — you understand the numbers rather than simply entering transactions.

Independent — you can manage your responsibilities without constant supervision.

Confidential and trustworthy — you will be working with sensitive financial information.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role means:

Books are accurate and up to date.

Bank and credit card accounts are reconciled consistently.

AP and AR are properly maintained.

Invoices are issued accurately and on time.

Outstanding receivables are actively monitored.

Month-end closing is completed on schedule.

Financial reports are accurate and reliable.

Errors and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

title: Walmart Marketplace Virtual Assistant (VA) — Product Research & WFS Specialist
description:
# Hiring: Experienced Walmart Marketplace VA — Product Research, Wholesale Sourcing & WFS



**Compensation:** $10–$15 USD/hour  

**Location:** Remote, worldwide  

**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 10 hours/week initially  

**Opportunity:** Long-term contract based on performance



### About Our Business



We are a U.S.-based general merchandise eCommerce company, already approved to sell on Walmart Marketplace.



We are seeking an experienced Walmart Marketplace Virtual Assistant specializing in product research, wholesale sourcing, and Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS).



Our business model focuses on reselling existing branded products through legitimate wholesale distributors and manufacturers.



**We are not looking for a private-label or dropshipping specialist.**



### Primary Responsibilities



**1. Walmart Product Research**



- Identify existing Walmart listings with consistent customer demand.

- Research estimated monthly sales, competition, seller count, and pricing history.

- Find profitable, lightweight products suitable for WFS.

- Analyze product trends, seasonality, and competition.

- Research opportunities across grocery, toys, pet supplies, health and household essentials, and kitchen/home products.



**2. Wholesale Supplier Research**



- Find legitimate U.S. wholesale distributors and manufacturers.

- Prioritize Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, and nationwide suppliers.

- Identify suppliers with opening orders around $300–$500 when possible.

- Verify wholesale pricing, MOQ, resale documentation, and product availability.

- Confirm whether the supplier and brand permit Walmart Marketplace resale.

- Identify opportunities for repeat wholesale purchases.



**3. WFS Operations**



- Evaluate WFS product eligibility and applicable restrictions.

- Calculate Walmart referral fees, WFS fulfillment fees, storage, inbound shipping, and estimated profitability.

- Assist with existing catalog matching and listing setup.

- Prepare compliant WFS shipment plans and inventory records.

- Monitor inventory, stockouts, pricing, and operational issues.

- Assist with WFS returns, reimbursements, and performance reporting.



### Target Product Criteria



- Walmart selling price: $20–$80

- Minimum target ROI: 30%

- Minimum target net profit: $5/unit

- Target net margin: 15%+

- Prefer consistent, year-round demand

- Prefer standard-size, lightweight products

- Prefer low-to-moderate seller competition

- Verified wholesale sourcing

- Walmart Marketplace and WFS eligible



### Required Qualifications



- Demonstrable experience with Walmart Marketplace Seller Center.

- Practical knowledge of Walmart Fulfillment Services.

- Experience researching existing Walmart listings.

- Ability to calculate complete landed costs and profitability.

- Experience sourcing from legitimate wholesale distributors.

- Excellent Google Sheets or Excel skills.

- Clear written English communication.

- Ability to document and verify research findings.



### Application Instructions



Please answer the following:



1. How many months or years have you worked with Walmart Marketplace?

2. What is your direct experience with WFS?

3. Which Walmart product research tools do you use?

4. Have you worked with U.S. wholesale distributors?

5. How do you calculate WFS net profit and ROI?

6. How do you verify Walmart resale authorization?

7. Can you provide an anonymized example of previous Walmart product research?

8. What is your hourly rate within our $10–$15 budget?



**Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid product research test.**



We value accuracy, ethical sourcing, transparent reporting, and long-term business relationships.

title: Call Center Manager - US Home Improvement Appointment Setting (Florida/California)
description:
Novara Construction LLC (
) is a US roofing and home-improvement company (kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, roof replacement and general construction) serving homeowners in South Florida. We run a remote outbound appointment-setting team and are looking for a highly experienced, professional Call Center Manager to lead, hire, train and grow it. We are only looking for candidates with proven experience managing outbound home-improvement call centers.



This is a leadership role, not just a supervisor seat. You will build the team, own the script, and be responsible for the quality of appointments, not just the volume.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Manage the daily operations of a remote outbound cold-calling team (appointment setters / teleagents)

- Recruit, interview and hire new agents alongside our recruiter

- Onboard and train agents on cold calling, rapport building, objection handling and appointment quality

- Build, test and continually improve call scripts for home-improvement offers

- Coach agents through call reviews and roleplays; manage underperformers

- Track and report KPIs: dials, contacts, booked appointments, show rate and sales conversion

- Manage rotating shift schedules and weekend coverage

- Work in our dialer and CRM systems (ReadyMode or similar) and keep data accurate



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of call center management or team lead experience

- Proven experience in outbound cold calling for US home improvement (roofing, solar, remodeling, windows, HVAC, energy efficiency or construction)

- Experience working with Florida and/or California markets and homeowners

- Hands-on experience hiring and training call center agents

- Experience writing and improving call scripts

- Strong computer skills and experience with dialer systems (ReadyMode, Five9, V
, Convoso or similar) and CRMs

- Strong personality and leadership presence: able to motivate, coach and hold a team accountable

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Reliable computer, headset, stable internet and a quiet workspace

- Someone who wants to grow with us long term



SCHEDULE & PAY

- Remote, independent contractor

- Full time, 9-hour shifts aligned with our US calling hours; some weekend coverage required

- $1,500/month base plus a team performance bonus based on verified appointments and sales



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short summary of the home-improvement campaigns you have managed (team size, appointments per day, show rate)

3. The dialer and CRM systems you have used

4. A short Loom video (3–5 minutes) with your camera on. Introduce yourself, then share your screen and walk us through how you would coach a new appointment setter: a sample script, how you handle a common homeowner objection, and how you track team results in a dialer/CRM or spreadsheet.



Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.

Novara Construction is a growing US roofing and construction company based in Florida, and we're building out our call center team. We're looking for TOP-PERFORMING, confident outbound callers who love the phone, can handle objections, and want to earn real commissions on top of a steady base.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make outbound calls to US homeowners in our target areas (Florida, Texas)

- Generate leads and qualify homeowners for roofing and construction services

- Book appointments for our in-person sales team

- Follow up with leads to confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates

- Log all activity accurately in our CRM / dialer (ReadyMode) and report weekly on calls and appointments



PAY (in USD, paid bi-weekly via Wise or wire)

- $5.00/hour base pay for all logged hours

- $25 for every appointment that shows

- $50 for every sale from your appointment

- $35 for a same-day showed appointment

- $60 for a same-day sale

- Plus weekly and monthly performance challenges and incentives

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

CTM Prospect Staging





Qualifications

At least 2-3 years of minimum work experience in a relevant or equivalent role

Comprehensive background in Customer and Administrative support

High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent English communication and comprehension

Proficiency in using and managing Google applications - Gmail, Calendar, Documents, Drive

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and a good quality headset and microphone.





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Part-Time Podcast Audio & Video Editor | Remote
description:

We are a growing US-based podcast and creative media production company seeking a skilled, creative, and dependable Podcast Audio & Video Editor to join our remote production team.



We specialize in professional podcast production, audio and video recording, digital storytelling, and multimedia content creation.



The ideal candidate has strong technical skills in both audio and video post-production, experience editing multicamera podcasts, and the ability to consistently deliver polished, professional content.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who enjoys creative storytelling, values quality, and works effectively within an organized remote team.



Key Responsibilities



1. Podcast Audio Editing & Post-Production (High Priority)



Strong professional audio editing skills are essential for this position.



Edit and enhance professionally recorded podcast audio.



Remove background noise, clicks, pops, unwanted pauses, and other audio distractions.



Apply EQ, compression, noise reduction, and audio leveling to achieve clear, balanced dialogue.



Synchronize externally recorded audio with video footage.



Balance audio levels across multiple speakers and microphones.

2. Multicamera Podcast Video Editing

Synchronize multiple camera angles with separately recorded audio.



Create smooth, natural camera transitions based on speaker activity and conversation flow.



Apply color correction and basic color grading.



Incorporate lower thirds, logos, titles, and branded graphics.



Remove mistakes, unnecessary pauses, and distractions.



Produce polished long-form podcast episodes for YouTube and other platforms.



Export completed videos according to required specifications.



3. Short-Form & Social Media Editing

Identify compelling highlights from long-form recordings.



Create attention-grabbing hooks and promotional clips.

Music video editing.



Audiobook and spoken-word audio editing.



Promotional videos and advertisements.



Client testimonials and behind-the-scenes content.



Other multimedia post-production projects.

Provide regular progress updates.

Attend scheduled team and production meetings.



Required Qualifications



Professional Experience



2–3 years of relevant professional editing experience preferred.



Demonstrated experience editing both audio and video podcasts.



Hands-on experience with multicamera podcast productions.



Ability to independently edit long-form podcasts and short-form social media content.



Portfolio demonstrating relevant podcast editing work.



Technical Skills



Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.



Experience with Adobe Audition, Reaper, Audacity, or comparable audio editing software.



Strong knowledge of EQ, compression, noise reduction, audio mixing, and dialogue enhancement.



Experience synchronizing externally recorded audio with multicamera footage.



Basic color correction and grading.



Experience creating captions, graphics, transitions, and social media content.



Understanding of professional audio and video export specifications.

Experience editing music videos, audiobooks, or other multimedia projects.



Familiarity with organized remote production workflows.



Professional Qualities



We are looking for someone who is:



Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.



Reliable, organized, and accountable.



Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English.

title: AI Video Editor - E-Commerce (FULL TIME EST)
description:
About Us



We are a US company that sells consumer products on Amazon, Walmart, Target and other online marketplaces, under our own brands and licensed brands. Video is a big part of how shoppers find and buy our products, and we are growing our in-house video work.



About the Role



We are looking for a creative and reliable video editor who uses AI tools every day. You will take product photos, specs and short briefs and turn them into clean, professional videos for our listings, ads and social media.



You will work directly with our team lead, who will send you several requests each week through Microsoft Teams. Some requests will need a same-day or next-day turnaround, so we need someone who responds quickly, communicates clearly and does not let tasks sit. This is a long-term role for the right person.



Your Tasks

• Create product videos for Amazon listings, Amazon Brand Stores, Sponsored Brands video ads, Walmart and Target product pages, and social media.

• Edit videos with callouts, text overlays, arrows and feature highlights that explain the product clearly in a few seconds.

• Add accurate, well-timed captions and subtitles, and proofread all text before sending.

• Generate and improve AI video and images using Qwen Cloud, and combine them with real product footage so the final video looks natural.

• Create natural-sounding English voiceovers in ElevenLabs that fit the product and target customer (US shoppers).

• Use ChatGPT, Claude or other LLMs to write scripts, hooks, shot lists and caption copy.

• Use Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Excel) to receive tasks, share drafts, track your work and organize files.

• Finish tasks from the team lead on time, send updates without being asked, and tell us early if something will be late.

• Export videos in the correct size, length and format for each platform.

• Build templates and brand kits so future videos are faster to make.



Requirements



• At least 2 years of video editing experience, with a portfolio that shows callouts, motion text and captions.

• Must have hands-on experience with Qwen Cloud, ElevenLabs, Microsoft 365, and ChatGPT or other LLMs and AI video tools. Please do not apply if you have not used these tools.

• Strong artistic eye for color, fonts, layout and pacing.

• Skilled in at least one editing program such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut.

• Good written and spoken English. All captions and scripts are for US customers, so grammar and spelling must be correct.

• Fast and responsive to tasks from the team lead, and able to handle more than one project at a time.

• Knows how to get consistent results from AI tools and how to fix the mistakes they make.

• Computer that can handle video editing smoothly, plus stable internet of at least [25] Mbps.

• Backup power and backup internet (for example, a UPS and mobile data) in case of brownouts or outages.

• Available to work during the schedule above and to be online on Microsoft Teams during working hours.



Nice to Have



• Experience making videos for Amazon, Walmart or Target sellers, and knowledge of Amazon video guidelines.

• Motion graphics or 3D product rendering skills.

• Product photography or graphic design skills.

• Experience with other AI tools such as Runway, Kling, Midjourney or Adobe Firefly.

• Previous work for US clients.



What We Offer



• Long-term, stable work with a growing US company.

• 13th month pay

• Performance-based raises and bonuses

• Paid subscriptions for the AI tools needed for the job

• Work from home with a supportive team lead and clear direction.



How to Apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include the following in your message:



• Put Elevenlabs in the subject line so we know you read the full post.

• A link to your portfolio or demo reel (Google Drive, YouTube or similar), with examples that include callouts and captions.

• A short note on which AI tools you have used (Qwen Cloud, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT or others) and what you made with them.

• Your expected monthly salary and when you can start.

• Your internet speed (a screenshot from a speed test is fine).



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short test task.

title: Qualified Accounting & Reconciliation Specialist - Legacy ERP Systems (Remote/Outsourced)
description:
Qualified Accounting & Reconciliation Specialist (Remote)



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced, **CPA-qualified Accounting & Reconciliation Specialist** to support our U.S.-based clients. This position involves much more than traditional bookkeeping or bank reconciliations. The ideal candidate will have a strong accounting background, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to work through detailed financial processes while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Primary responsibilities include bank and credit card reconciliations, general ledger balancing, month-end close procedures, financial reporting, and extensive spreadsheet-based financial analysis.



The position requires someone who can **follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), identify discrepancies, investigate accounting issues, and ensure financial records are accurate and complete.**



Experience with RFMS or other legacy ERP systems is strongly preferred. Familiarity with AI-assisted reconciliation and financial analysis tools is a plus.



Key Responsibilities



**Bank Reconciliations & General Ledger Accounting**

- Perform bank and credit card reconciliations across multiple client accounts and ERP systems.

- Investigate missing, duplicated, incorrectly posted, and outstanding transactions.

- Review and reconcile checks, deposits, transfers, bank charges, and other financial activity.

- Identify discrepancies between bank statements, supporting schedules, and general ledger balances.

- Prepare and post approved journal entries, adjustments, transfers, and other accounting transactions.

- Research and resolve reconciliation differences while maintaining accurate supporting documentation.



**Month-End Close & Financial Reporting**

- Complete assigned month-end close procedures following established SOPs and checklists.

- Review general ledger accounts for accuracy, completeness, and proper classification.

- Reconcile balance sheet accounts and supporting schedules.

- Identify unusual balances, posting errors, and inconsistencies requiring correction.

- Prepare and review financial reports, account analyses, and reconciliation summaries.

- Ensure assigned close procedures are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

- Escalate unresolved accounting issues and discrepancies promptly.



**Spreadsheet Analysis & Financial Data Review**

- Work extensively in Excel to organize, compare, reconcile, and analyze financial data.

- Prepare and maintain reconciliation workbooks, supporting schedules, and financial reports.

- Compare large datasets across bank statements, ERP reports, and general ledger records.

- Use formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, and other Excel tools to investigate discrepancies.

title: AI Automation Developer – Lead Generation & Data Integration (West Texas)
description:
We're an equipment rental company in West Texas. We want an automated system that checks public permit and bid sources every day, turns each new permit into a qualified lead, and hands it to our sales team. Today a VA does this by hand from a written playbook, which we'll share with you.



What the system must do



  1.    Collect. Pull new records every day from:

  •    Texas Railroad Commission drilling permits (W-1). Use the RRC's official bulk data files, not page scraping. The RRC shuts off sessions that use automated tools on its search pages.

  •    TDLR TABS construction project registrations

  •    City permit reports for Midland, Odessa, Big Spring, San Angelo and Lubbock

  •    Public bid awards from TxDOT, the Texas state bid board (ESBD), and city, county and school district bid pages

  2.    Filter. Keep only our counties and the job types that need heavy equipment.

  3.    Enrich. Find each company's website, office phone and the right decision-maker: superintendent, project manager, operations manager or fleet manager.

  4.    Score. Rank each lead by project size and start date, and guess what equipment they'll need.

  5.    Log. Add new leads to our CRM or a shared spreadsheet with no duplicates.

  6.    Alert. Send sales a daily summary by
 or text, with the hottest leads first.

  7.    Draft outreach. Write a short personal
 for each lead. A human reviews it before anything is sent.



Requirements



  •    Use only public data, and follow each site's terms of use

  •    A person approves outreach before it goes out

  •    A simple dashboard showing leads found, contacted and won, and which source each lead came from

  •    Documentation and a handoff video so we can run it without you



To apply, tell us



  •    Similar lead-gen or scraping automations you've built (links or screenshots)

  •    Which tools you'd use (Python, n8n, Make, Zapier, Claude or ChatGPT, etc.) and why

  •    Monthly running cost after setup

  •    Fixed price and timeline. Phase 1 is RRC and TDLR to the spreadsheet with daily alerts. Phase 2 is the remaining sources and the outreach drafts.

title: Senior KYC/KYB Analyst
description:
About Us



We are an international company working with a remote team in the Philippines since 2008. We value professionalism, collaboration, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced global environment. Our team thrives on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we’re looking for someone who shares these values.



About You

We are looking for a highly accurate, detail-oriented, and analytical KYC/KYB Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and KYB checks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting our onboarding and verification processes. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, works with integrity, and is comfortable handling sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own end-to-end KYC and KYB reviews for individual and corporate customers, from onboarding through approval, rejection, or escalation.

- Review and verify identity documents, proof of address, company registration documents, and complex ownership and control structures, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and controllers.

- Carry out Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk customers, including PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, complex or opaque structures, crypto/Web3 businesses and unusual activity profiles.

- Assess and evidence source of funds and source of wealth, and challenge customers where the explanation or documents are inconsistent or insufficient.

- Perform AML screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), resolve potential matches and document a clear rationale for each decision.

- Complete customer risk assessments, assign risk ratings, and recommend approval, conditional approval, or rejection for complex and high-risk cases.

- Escalate suspicious activity and red flags to the Head of Compliance, with well-documented case summaries to support any internal suspicious activity report.

- Run periodic reviews and re-verification based on customer risk level, including trigger-based reviews when ownership, activity, or risk profile changes.

- Manage verification workflows in Sumsub (or similar KYC/AML tools), including configuring checks, resolving system issues, and flagging improvements.

- Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from banking and payment partners, preparing clear, complete case files within agreed timelines

- Work with Support, Business, Product and Tech teams across multiple business units to resolve discrepancies, chase outstanding information and unblock stuck cases.

- Contribute to improving KYC/KYB procedures, checklists and risk-assessment frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and partner expectations.

- Keep accurate, audit-ready records for every check and decision.

- Handle confidential and sensitive customer data with discretion, in line with data protection requirements.



REQUIREMENTS:

1–3 years of proven, hands-on experience in KYC and KYB verification, with a strong focus on reviewing and validating KYB documentation

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to efficiently identify inconsistencies, risks, and missing information

- Proven experience following and adhering to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines

- Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar AML/KYC tools (e.g., Veriff, Onfido, Persona, ComplyAdvantage)

- Solid understanding of AML, KYC, and compliance processes, particularly in a B2B context

- Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

- Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively

- Availability: Must be available and responsive during the agreed 8-hour shift

- Good Internet Connection: Reliable and stable for remote work

- Must have a Wise account or reside in a location that supports Wise

- Willingness to learn Geolayer3 map animations



Preferred Skills

- Experience with 2D or 3D animations

- Familiarity with organized Dropbox workflows.

Full-Time | 45 Hours/Week | $600/Month + Performance Commissions



We're looking for an exceptional Customer Service & Operations Manager who is proactive, dependable, confident on the phone, and capable of taking ownership of daily business operations.



This is not a position for someone who simply waits for instructions. We're looking for someone who anticipates problems, follows through on responsibilities, and actively contributes to the company's growth.



Your Responsibilities



Customer Service & Bookings: Respond promptly to inquiries, answer calls, convert leads into bookings, and provide an exceptional customer experience.

Appointment Fulfillment: Coordinate licensed massage therapists, manage schedules, confirm appointments, and resolve last-minute challenges.

Therapist Recruitment: Source, screen, and onboard qualified licensed massage therapists.

Client Retention: Follow up with past clients, encourage repeat bookings, and support our review and referral initiatives.

Business Development: Follow up with corporate prospects and assist with local business outreach and wellness event opportunities.

Daily Accountability: Maintain accurate CRM records, document activities, track results, and provide end-of-day updates.

Excellent spoken and written English, with clear and professional phone communication.

Strong customer service experience, preferably supporting U.S.-based customers.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Confidence handling difficult conversations and solving unexpected problems.

Ability to work independently and take initiative.

Experience with CRM systems, appointment scheduling, or remote operations is an advantage.

Reliable internet, a quiet working environment, and availability during scheduled New York business hours.

3% commission for assisting in closing eligible corporate wellness deals.

6% commission for independently sourcing and closing eligible corporate wellness deals.

A performance-based salary review will take place after 90 days, with the potential to increase the base salary to $700/month based on demonstrated results.

How to Apply

**Your updated resume.

**A  video or voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your customer service experience.

title: Graphic Designer/ Social Media Expert
description:
About the role



CitiZEN DOG NYC is hiring a graphic designer to start immediately. We need print-ready holiday marketing assets at the printer on deadline, and then a steady flow of fresh work after that.

We're a New York canine training and dog food brand. Our line includes Disco SNAX, a human-grade dog food. We want a designer who gets the brand quickly and brings ideas of their own, not someone who waits for a detailed brief. Direction is available, but we want to be surprised by what you show us.



What you'll do

• Design posters for the holiday season and ongoing promotions

• Create stickers and other small-format print pieces

• Produce Instagram content: feed posts, stories and carousel graphics

• Prepare print-ready files that meet printer specs (bleed, CMYK, resolution) and hit holiday deadlines

• Pitch original concepts and visual directions without waiting for a brief

• Keep the CitiZEN DOG NYC and Disco SNAX look consistent across print and social



Who you are

• A self-starter who can take an idea from first sketch to finished file on your own

• Quick to pick up a brand's voice and personality, ideally from day one

• Full of fresh ideas, with designs that stand out on a shelf, a wall or a feed

• Comfortable with fast turnarounds and real print deadlines

• Open to feedback, and confident enough to push a bold idea

• Bonus: you love dogs and know NYC's style



Requirements

• A portfolio showing print work (posters, stickers or packaging) and social media design

• Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, or similar tools

• Experience preparing files for professional printers

• Available to start right away



Nice to have

• Experience with food, pet or consumer product brands

• Illustration or hand-lettering skills

• Basic motion or short video skills for Instagram Reels

title: Customer Support Specialist – EU e-commerce clients (long-term, small team)
description:
We're a small digital marketing company working with e-commerce brands across Europe. We're hiring one person for customer support, and we want them to stay for years.



THE ROLE

You'll be the person our clients talk to. You'll answer them on 
 and
, solve their problems or get them solved, and keep our dashboards and spreadsheets up to date. This is a customer support role, and it stays one. Support is the core of the job, not a phase you pass through.



Small teams grow. If we grow and you prove yourself, there may be room later to take on more: owning processes, handling the hardest cases, maybe guiding new people. We're not promising a title. We're promising that good work here gets seen and rewarded.



HOURS (Amsterdam time)

Shift A: 08:00–16:00 (= 15:00–23:00 PH time)

Shift B: 16:00–00:00 (= 23:00–07:00 PH time)

3–5 days a week to start, building to full-time.

(PH times are for Nov–Mar. From late March they shift 1 hour earlier.)



You'll need a laptop, stable internet, and a quiet place to work. A lot of the work can be done from your phone, but not all of it.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

We can teach you our tools and systems. We can't teach attitude. We're looking for:

- Ownership. When something goes wrong, you fix it or flag it. You don't wait to be told.

- Reliability. You do what you say, on time, without anyone chasing you.

- You actually care about helping people. Clients can tell when you don't.

- You stay calm and respectful when a client is frustrated.

- You want to get better every month, and you take feedback without getting defensive.

- Good written English. You'll be writing to European business owners every day, so this one isn't optional.



Nice to have: experience in e-commerce or customer support, or using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work faster.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



1. Record a Loom video (
, it's free) of 3–5 minutes. Keep your camera on. Don't read from a script; we want to see you, not a speech. Answer these:

   - Who are you, and what drives you outside of work?

   - Tell us about a time you did more than you were asked, when nobody was checking. What happened?

   - Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What did you do next?

   - A client messages you angry about something that isn't your fault. What do you do?

   - Why customer support, and why a long-term role in a small company?



2. Send us a message that starts with the word "ANCHOR". Include:

   - Your Loom link (check that it's set to public/viewable. If we can't open it, we skip it.)

   - Which shift you want: A, B, or both

   - When you could start



That's all. No cover letter, no CV attachment needed at this stage.
