title: Part-Time Operations & Marketing Manager / Executive Assistant
description:
Company: Believe & Build Consulting / BBCo Agency

Location: Remote

Schedule: Part-time; proposed starting commitment of 10–15 hours per week, with final hours agreed before hiring

Compensation: Based on experience; please include your hourly rate



About the business



Believe & Build Consulting and BBCo Funding Agency help emerging business owners and investors build the relationships, preparation, and funding strategies needed to move forward.



We’re looking for a proactive, organized professional to work directly with founder and turn business priorities into completed projects, consistent marketing, and clear daily operations.



The role



You will help organize and coordinate our CRM setup, marketing execution, AI automations, specialist hiring, and ongoing business operations. You should be comfortable managing projects, communicating with contractors, and completing hands-on administrative and marketing tasks.



You do not need to personally perform every technical task. You do need to recognize what requires a specialist, write a clear brief, track the work, and verify that deliverables meet the agreed requirements.



Your initial priorities



1. Coordinate our GoHighLevel / Peak Connector implementation



* Attend onboarding and setup calls with the founder.

* Turn each call into clear action items, owners, and deadlines.

* Coordinate CRM setup, contact organization, pipelines, dashboards, calendars, and follow-up workflows.

* Track website and landing-page deliverables for current offers.

* Coordinate appropriate AI-agent setup, testing, and documentation with technical support.

* Complete basic platform tasks within your demonstrated abilities and escalate technical work when needed.



2. Help recruit and manage a VSL / Meta ads specialist



* Organize applications, portfolios, and candidate information.

* Screen candidates against a provided scorecard.

* Coordinate interviews and paid assessments.

* Compare proposals, pricing, scope, and delivery timelines.

* Track the selected specialist’s progress on video, funnel, advertising, and automation deliverables.

* Coordinate testing and handoff before launch.



Our current target is a tested funding funnel and advertising launch by December 1, 2026. Please explain what you can realistically help deliver within that timeline and identify any dependencies.



3. Create a consistent content-production process & content management



* Maintain a practical content calendar and production tracker.

* Prepare filming briefs, scripts, and shot lists.

* Coordinate batch filming of at least three videos per session.

* Organize footage and communicate editing instructions.

* Coordinate editing, captions, approval, scheduling, and publishing.

* Repurpose approved content across relevant channels.

* Track basic performance and recommend useful adjustments.

*Hands-on short-form video editing.

 

If editing requires a separate specialist, you should be able to manage that workflow.



4. Keep daily operations moving



* Maintain one clear project board with priorities, deadlines, and next steps.

* Organize meetings, notes, files, and follow-ups.

* Document repeatable processes.

* Flag missing information and stalled work early.

* Send concise progress updates with recommendations.

* Help prevent leads, commitments, and deliverables from falling through the cracks.



What success looks like in your first 30 days



* One organized project board with clear ownership and deadlines.

* A documented CRM implementation plan complete

* A well-managed specialist hiring process.

* A repeatable content workflow from filming through publishing.

* Clear follow-up responsibilities and simple operating procedures.

* The founder can quickly see what is completed, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have supported a founder, small business, agency, or consulting practice.

* Can turn a voice note or meeting into an actionable plan.

* Follow through without needing repeated reminders.

* Communicate clearly and ask thoughtful questions.

* Experience with social media and content management

* Can balance project coordination with hands-on execution.

* Are comfortable with Google Workspace and a project-management tool.

* Have experience with GoHighLevel or can demonstrate experience coordinating similar CRM systems.

* Handle confidential business and client information responsibly.

* Can provide some working-hour overlap with US Eastern Time.



Experience with real estate, lending, financial services, funnels, or founder-led content businesses is helpful.



How to apply



Begin your application with “Implementation Partner” and include:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role fits your experience.

2. An example of a project you helped move from idea to completion, including your specific responsibilities.

3. Your experience with GoHighLevel, contractor coordination, recruiting, and content management.

4. Which tasks you can personally execute and which you would delegate to a specialist.

5. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, earliest start date, and Eastern Time overlap.

6. Your approach to organizing a founder who shares ideas through voice notes and has several competing priorities.

7. A brief outline of what you would prioritize during your first week.



Relevant work samples are welcome. Please redact confidential information. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid assessment before a longer engagement.

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Cold & Warm Calling  (Remote, Full-Time/Part-Time)
description:
Company: Harvest Panel Systems (Harvest Panels) — Oklahoma, USA Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, US Central Time business hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT)  - Pay $8 base + commission/bonus



About Us

Harvest Panel Systems distributes insulated metal panels (IMPs), cooler doors and trim from Oklahoma to customers across the US. We serve contractors, builders and owners of cold storage facilities, walk-in coolers and freezers, cultivation and grow rooms, food processing plants, cleanrooms and metal buildings. Our panels are in stock and ship nationwide.



The Role

You will be the voice of Harvest Panels on the phone. You will make outbound cold calls, call warm leads from our
 campaigns and website, and follow up on quotes until they close. You will work hand-in-hand with our
 campaign specialist so every lead gets the right call at the right time. Because you will speak directly with American contractors and business owners, perfect spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent is essential.



Responsibilities

• Make 60–100+ outbound calls per day to contractors, builders and facility owners

• Call warm leads who opened, clicked or replied to our
 campaigns, and inbound web inquiries

• Follow up on sent quotes, estimates and past conversations

• Qualify leads: project type, size (square footage), timeline, location and decision-maker

• Book calls and estimate requests for our sales team; collect floor plans and project details

• Log every call, outcome, note and next step in Pipedrive (our CRM) the same day

• Coordinate with the
 specialist on timing, talk tracks and lead priorities

• Leave clear, professional voi
s and send short follow-up
s after calls

• Report daily call numbers and weekly results (connects, conversations, appointments, quotes)



Requirements

• Native-level spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent — this is the #1 requirement

• 2+ years of outbound sales or cold-calling experience for US clients (B2B strongly preferred)

• Confident, friendly and persistent; comfortable handling objections and rejection

• CRM experience; Pipedrive preferred (HubSpot or Salesforce also considered)

• Able to learn technical product details (panel thickness, R-values, door types) and explain them simply

• High-quality USB headset with noise cancelling, quiet workspace, reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power/internet

• Available to work US Central Time business hours



Nice to Have

• Experience selling construction, building materials, HVAC/refrigeration or industrial products

• Experience with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, JustCall, Kixie or similar)



How to Apply

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume

2. Links to your website, portfolio or LinkedIn (if applicable)

3. A short list of past work and projects you have handled (company or industry, your role, and results if available)

4. A voice recording (MP3 or a Vocaroo/Google Drive link) of you reading the script below in a natural, conversational sales tone. Do not use any audio editing or filters. Record in one take, 1–2 minutes

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available start date



Voice Recording Script (for Job Ad 2 applicants)

Applicants read this aloud as if on a live cold call. It runs about 90 seconds and includes product terms, numbers, US place names and an objection, so you can judge accent, pronunciation, pacing and tone.

Instructions for applicants: Read the script below as if you are speaking to a real contractor on the phone. Sound natural and friendly, not robotic. Words in [brackets] are for you to fill in (use your own first name).



Opening

"Hi, is this Mike? Great. Mike, this is [Your Name] with Harvest Panel Systems out of Oklahoma. I know I'm catching you out of the blue, so I'll be quick. Do you have about thirty seconds?"



Reason for the call

"Thanks. We supply insulated metal panels, cooler doors and trim to contractors building cold storage, walk-in coolers and freezers, grow rooms and food processing facilities. I'm calling because a lot of builders we talk to are dealing with long lead times and rising material costs, and we've been able to help with both."



Value

"Our panels combine the wall, the insulation, the vapor barrier and the finish in one product, so crews can install them much faster than traditional framing. Our four-inch panel is rated R-thirty, and we keep stock lengths of ten, twelve, fourteen, sixteen and twenty feet ready to ship from our warehouse in Piedmont, Oklahoma. Stock orders can usually reach you anywhere in the continental U.S. within forty-eight hours after they leave our facility."



Handling an objection

"Totally understand you already have a supplier. Most of our customers did too. We're not asking you to switch today. We just offer a best price guarantee, so if you send us a competitor's written quote, we'll take a look and match it. That way you've got a reliable backup when your usual supplier is backordered."



Close

"Do you have any projects coming up in the next three to six months? If you can send over a floor plan, our team will put together a free estimate and design layout for you. What's the best
 to send that to? Perfect. I'll send it over today and give you a follow-up call on Thursday. Thanks for your time, Mike, and have a great afternoon."

title: Property Management Accountant / Accounting Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote

Schedule — 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CST



Ideal Candidate



You are an experienced accounting professional with mandatory hands-on Buildium experience and a strong understanding of property management accounting. You confidently manage tenant and owner accounts, process vendor invoices, reconcile rental and escrow accounts, and support monthly closeouts and owner distributions. You work independently, communicate proactively, and consistently maintain accurate financial records.



About the Role



We are seeking a Property Management Accountant / Accounting Specialist to support the daily financial operations of a property management business. You will maintain accounting records in Buildium, reconcile designated accounts, and prepare monthly owner distributions while following established financial procedures and approval controls.



Key Responsibilities

- Create and maintain tenant, property, and property owner accounts in Buildium, ensuring information is accurate and current.

- Review and enter vendor invoices, allocate expenses to the correct property or owner account, and maintain supporting documentation.

- Perform daily reconciliations of designated escrow and rental accounts, verifying deposits, rent payments, invoices, and expenses.

- Investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections, and escalate unresolved accounting issues.

- Support monthly property closeouts by reviewing rental income, management fees, vendor expenses, and other applicable deductions.

- Calculate balances due to property owners and prepare owner distributions and wire transactions through Buildium for management review and approval.

- Maintain organized financial records and provide updates on accounting activities, missing documentation, and outstanding matters.

- Coordinate with the property management team to resolve invoice questions and obtain required financial information.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial administration.

- Hands-on experience using Buildium is required.

- Strong understanding of property management accounting, including rental income, security deposits, escrow accounts, and property expenses.

- Experience managing tenant and property owner accounts.

- Knowledge of accounts payable, vendor invoice processing, and expense allocation.

- Experience performing bank and daily financial reconciliations.

- Experience supporting monthly financial closeouts and owner distributions.

- Excellent attention to detail, organization, and analytical skills.

- Clear written and verbal communication.

- Ability to work independently and manage recurring accounting deadlines.

- Availability to work full-time from 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting a property management company or real estate accounting team.

- Experience managing accounting records across multiple properties and owner accounts.

- Familiarity with Property Meld.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience working remotely with property management teams.

Property Meld training and guidance on internal workflows will be provided during onboarding.



Financial Responsibilities and Approval Controls



This role handles transaction recording, reconciliation, and payment preparation. Management retains authority over transfers between company bank accounts and approval of owner wire distributions prepared through Buildium. Check issuance sits with the designated company personnel.



Regular reconciliation responsibilities cover the designated escrow and rental accounts. Management oversees the company’s operating account.





Send your resume and video/ audio intro telling us your experience in property management accounting

title: Luxury E-Commerce Web Designer (UI/UX & Figma)
description:
LUXURY E-COMMERCE WEB DESIGNER

UI/UX & Figma Specialist

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and portfolio)  

Schedule: Part-Time / Project-Based, approximately 10–20 hours per week

Location: Remote – Philippines



ABOUT WOOD & CO.



- Wood & Co. is a New York-based luxury millwork manufacturer specializing in exceptional custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural interiors.

- For over a decade, we have worked with architects, interior designers, builders, and discerning homeowners on high-end residential projects throughout New York City, Long Island, and the Hamptons.

- We are now developing our Wood & Co. E-Commerce Platform, a curated collection of luxury, made-to-order furniture pieces and select cabinetry.

- Our objective is to create an online shopping experience that reflects the craftsmanship, sophistication, and attention to detail found in our physical products.





THE OPPORTUNITY



- We are looking for an exceptionally talented UI/UX Web Designer with outstanding visual taste and a sophisticated design aesthetic.

- We want to build a website that feels like a luxury furniture showroom—elegant, timeless, thoughtfully curated, and effortless to navigate.

- This is primarily a visual design and user experience position, not a website development or project management role.

- You will join our existing website team, which includes a website consultant, developer, and product development coordinator.

- Our team is already developing product specifications, available configurations, and preliminary wireframes.

- Your role will be to transform these ideas into exceptional, polished, developer-ready website designs.

- We want someone who brings creative ideas to the table, challenges conventional thinking, and elevates our original concepts.





YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Design sophisticated, visually compelling e-commerce website interfaces.

- Develop homepage, collection page, and individual product page designs.

- Transform preliminary wireframes into polished, high-fidelity Figma designs.

- Design intuitive interfaces for selecting furniture dimensions, materials, finishes, and customization options.

- Create exceptional desktop and mobile experiences.

- Establish consistent typography, layouts, spacing, and reusable design components.

- Develop intuitive navigation and product discovery experiences.

- Balance beautiful visual storytelling with practical e-commerce functionality.

- Prepare organized, developer-ready Figma files.

- Collaborate directly with our product development coordinator and website developer.

- Participate in design reviews and refine concepts based on feedback.

- Independently identify opportunities to improve the website's visual presentation and user experience.





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- An exceptional portfolio demonstrating sophisticated website design.

- Advanced proficiency in Figma.

- Strong understanding of UI and UX principles.

- Experience designing premium or visually sophisticated e-commerce websites.

- Outstanding eye for typography, layout, composition, spacing, and detail.

- Experience creating responsive desktop and mobile designs.

- Ability to transform wireframes and functional requirements into polished designs.

- Understanding of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion principles.

- Ability to independently develop and clearly explain creative concepts.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Reliable communication and the ability to work independently.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:



- Luxury furniture and home furnishings.

- Architecture and interior design.

- Premium fashion or lifestyle brands.

- Shopify e-commerce.

- Customizable or configurable products.

- E-commerce conversion optimization.

- Design systems and developer handoff.



Experience in these industries is preferred but not mandatory.



An outstanding portfolio is more important to us than formal qualifications or years of experience.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- We're looking for someone with exceptional creative judgment and a genuine passion for beautiful design.

- Someone who understands the difference between a website that simply looks attractive and one that feels truly sophisticated.

- We appreciate refined, timeless design rather than passing trends.

- Beautiful typography. Thoughtful composition. Elegant layouts. Attention to the smallest details.

- We want a designer who can bring original ideas, thoughtfully explain design decisions, and confidently recommend improvements.

- We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or relies on generic templates.

- We value exceptional design quality, independent thinking, and attention to detail above everything else.





WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You will collaborate with an established team responsible for different aspects of the website:



- Website Consultant: Oversees project direction and development coordination.

- Product Development Coordinator: Establishes product specifications, customization options, and preliminary wireframes.

- Website Developer: Handles implementation, technical functionality, and website development.

- You – UI/UX Designer: Own the visual and interactive design experience, creating polished Figma designs ready for implementation.



You will not be expected to write code, manage developers, or independently determine every product requirement.



However, you should be comfortable collaborating directly with team members, presenting creative concepts, and ensuring your designs can be effectively implemented.



COMPENSATION & ENGAGEMENT

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and portfolio)  



- This is a project-based freelance engagement, rather than a traditional full-time position.  BUT could transition to a full-time role or long-term part time role.  (We have multiple project launches)

- We anticipate approximately 10–20 hours per week, depending on project requirements.  This project has multiple phases with an initial launch in 6 months, but extended product launches every 6 months for next two years.

- Work will be organized around clearly defined design deliverables and milestones, with agreed weekly hour allocations.

- We expect to begin with a smaller initial engagement to establish design compatibility, evaluate work quality, and develop the initial creative direction.



Following a successful initial engagement, there is potential for additional projects and ongoing collaboration.



We value efficiency, creative thinking, and exceptional work—not simply hours worked.



HOW TO APPLY



We want to keep our application process simple and efficient.



Please submit the following THREE items:



1. YOUR PORTFOLIO



- Provide a link to your portfolio and identify THREE of your strongest website design projects.

- We are particularly interested in luxury, premium e-commerce, furniture, interior design, fashion, and lifestyle websites.

- For each project, briefly describe your specific contribution.

- We want to see exceptional typography, composition, visual storytelling, and intuitive user experiences.



2. A 60-SECOND INTRODUCTION VIDEO



- Please record a short video introducing yourself and tell us:

- Your name and a brief overview of your design experience.

- What types of websites you specialize in.

- Why this particular opportunity interests you.



A simple video recorded on your phone, webcam, or Loom is perfectly acceptable.



No editing or professional production is necessary.



We simply want an opportunity to meet you and hear directly from you.



3. YOUR RATE & AVAILABILITY



Please include:



- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your typical weekly availability.

- Your earliest available start date.



IMPORTANT: Applications without both a portfolio and a 60-second introduction video will not be considered.





WHY WORK WITH WOOD & CO. ATELIER?



This is an opportunity to help shape the digital experience of an emerging luxury furniture brand backed by an established New York manufacturer.



You'll work alongside an existing team, collaborate directly with decision-makers, and have meaningful creative input into the visual identity and customer experience of our online store.



We value thoughtful collaboration, exceptional craftsmanship, attention to detail, and long-term professional relationships.



We're looking for a talented designer who shares those values and takes genuine pride in creating exceptional work.



We look forward to reviewing your portfolio and meeting you!

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
Role Summary



PawPay is a growing company focused on delivering innovative financial solutions for the veterinary industry. As our team continues to expand, we are looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist who can take ownership of our employee training programs, learning materials, and professional development initiatives. We are looking for someone who is not only an experienced trainer but also a strong content creator, researcher, and LMS administrator who can independently develop engaging learning experiences.







Key Responsibilities



Training Material Development & Content Creation

Learning Management System (LMS) Administration

Training Facilitation & Employee Development

Research & Learning Program Improvement

Training Administration & Coordination

Others to follow



Qualifications



At least 2 years of professional experience as a Trainer, Training Specialist, Learning & Development Specialist, or similar role.

Hands-on experience creating training materials is mandatory, including presentations, instructional guides, e-learning modules, and assessments.

Practical experience using and administering a Learning Management System (LMS) is mandatory. Experience with TalentLMS, Moodle, Docebo, or similar platforms is acceptable.

Proven experience facilitating training sessions, preferably in a remote or virtual work environment.

Strong research skills, with the ability to independently gather, validate, and organize information into effective learning materials.

A creative eye for visual design, presentation layout, and engaging educational content.

Familiarity with training administration, including scheduling, attendance tracking, progress monitoring, reporting, and documentation.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Google Workspace, and other content creation tools.

Ability to work independently, proactively communicate updates, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Must be available to conduct training, onboarding, and coordination meetings during assigned PST working hours.





Preferred Candidate



We’re looking for someone who is:



Experience in BPO, SaaS, fintech, insurance, customer service, or other fast-paced industries.

Experience developing structured onboarding programs and employee certification pathways.

Familiarity with instructional design principles, such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, or adult learning methodologies.

Experience using AI-powered content creation and research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gamma, or similar platforms.

Basic video editing, graphic design, or interactive course creation experience.

Experience conducting training needs analysis (TNA) and measuring training effectiveness.

Experience supporting leadership development, compliance training, and employee engagement initiatives.

What we're looking for: 



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the L&D function rather than simply facilitate training sessions.



Our ideal candidate is:



Creative: Can transform ordinary training content into engaging and visually appealing learning experiences.

Resourceful: Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics and independently developing learning materials.

Organized: Can manage training calendars, LMS assignments, attendance, deadlines, and reports without constant supervision.

Proactive: Regularly provides updates, identifies potential issues early, and follows through on commitments.

Confident Trainer: Comfortable conducting live virtual sessions and engaging employees with different experience levels.

Tech-Savvy: Familiar with digital learning platforms, collaboration tools, and AI-assisted content creation.

Dependable: Available during agreed working hours and responsive to training requests and team coordination.



If you’re someone who thrives in a results-oriented, entrepreneurial environment and wants to grow quickly, this is the right place for you.

title: B2B Sales Rep / Cold Caller Who Closes — U.S. Web Design Company ($3/hr + $20 Per Paid Customer)
description:
Elvarrio is a U.S.-based web design company in Massachusetts. We build affordable websites for small businesses that don't have one yet.



PLEASE READ — THIS IS A SALES POSITION.

This is NOT just appointment-setting. This is NOT "send the lead to the owner and move on."

In this job, YOU capture the lead, YOU call them back, YOU follow up every day, and YOU try to close them. The businesses you bring in are YOUR leads until they buy, say no, or close out.

If you only want to dial and set appointments for someone else to close, do not apply. If you like following up, getting the owner back on the phone, walking them through what you sent them, and asking for the sale — this is for you.

We provide everything: the leads, the CloudTalk calling system with a U.S. business number, the exact scripts for the first call AND the closing call, full training, your own follow-up sheet, and a training portal you can study anytime.



Your job has 2 parts, every single day



1. FOLLOW UP AND CLOSE YOUR OWN LEADS — this comes first

Every business you capture gets a free personalized demo website built for them that same day by our owner, Mike.

The next day, YOU call them back — exactly like you promised them on the first call: "I will follow up with you tomorrow to go over it."

On that closing call you will:

• Text them the demo link right before you call so they can open it on their phone while you talk

• Get the owner to actually open the demo LIVE on the call — not "I'll look at it later"

• Walk them through it in about 2 minutes — what it does, why it helps them get found on Google

• Tell them the price clearly: $499 one time, hosting is free, no contract. Optional care plan is $29/month if they want us to handle updates for them

• Ask for the sale, handle "I need to think about it" / price / timing questions using our script, and try to close it down

• End every closing call one of 3 ways only: YES, an exact booked callback day + time, or a clear NO

If they don't answer or don't close that day, you try again in your second closing block the same day, you note everything in your sheet, and you keep working them the next day until they buy, book a firm next step, or are closed out. Promised callback times ALWAYS come before new dialing.

You do NOT collect payment yourself. When a customer says YES, you message Mike right away with their confirmed
 and any changes they want. Mike sends the agreement + payment link the same day. A sale counts as closed only when the $499 is PAID — and that's when your $20 bonus counts too.

You can quote the $499 price above. You CANNOT offer discounts, promise a $0-down plan, promise a bigger/custom website, or promise a launch date — those go to Mike. If you're not sure, ask Mike, don't guess.



2. CALL NEW BUSINESSES AND CAPTURE NEW LEADS

In between your closing blocks, you call small businesses across the United States from our lead lists using our script. You offer them a FREE personalized demo website built with their actual business name, phone number, and services — free to look at, no obligation.

When a business says yes, you capture 4 things on the call, in this order:

The decision maker's name

Their best
 address

Their best phone number

The name of the person you spoke with

Then, live on that same call/shift:

• You send the capture to Mike on Google Chat with the company info — Mike builds the demo, messages you back "done," and puts the demo link on your follow-up sheet

• You add a call note and disposition in CloudTalk after EVERY call

• You make the promise that sets up tomorrow: "I will follow up with you tomorrow to go over it"

Those captures become YOUR closing list tomorrow. That's the whole flow: capture today, close tomorrow, keep following up until it's a yes or a no.



What a normal trial shift looks like (10 AM–3 PM ET)

• 10:00–11:30 AM — Closing Block 1: call back your own leads from your follow-up sheet

• 11:30 AM–1:00 PM — Dialer: call new businesses, capture new leads

• 1:00–2:00 PM — Closing Block 2: promised callbacks first, then second tries from the morning

• 2:00–2:45 PM — Dialer again

• 2:45–3:00 PM — Update your sheet notes + send Mike your short daily report

You also get a 30-minute PAID break each trial shift (one 30-min or two 15-min breaks).

Day 1 you have no closing list yet — you train, study the closing script, and dial. From Day 2 on, your closing list is yesterday's captures, and it grows every day you capture.



Schedule

• Paid 2-week trial: Monday–Friday, 10 AM–3 PM U.S. Eastern Time (10 PM–3 AM Philippine Time) — 25 hours/week

• After a successful trial: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM U.S. Eastern Time (8 PM–5 AM Philippine Time), full-time ongoing work

You must be available for the full shift, every weekday. This is a long-term position for the right person — not a short gig.



Pay

• $3/hour, paid weekly

• PLUS $20 bonus for every customer YOU captured AND closed who buys a website project and pays

Important: the $20 is paid when your customer actually pays for the project — not per call, not per capture, not per demo sent, and not per "yes" that doesn't pay. Good closers earn this over and over on top of hourly pay because they work their own list every day instead of letting leads go cold.

You will be measured on real closing work, not just dials: owners reached, demos opened live on the call, how many you got to the price, exact next steps booked, and sales PAID — plus 100+ dials per shift on your new-lead dialing.

Please read: All calls are recorded, and captures, follow-ups, and bonuses are verified against the recordings and your sheet notes. We pay for real work, and we check. If you're a genuine salesperson, this protects you — your real work gets seen and credited to you.



We're looking for

• Excellent spoken English with a confident, friendly, natural phone presence

• Real outbound sales experience calling U.S. businesses — cold calling AND follow-up/closing experience strongly preferred

• Someone who does NOT accept "I'll look at it later" and walk away — you politely book the exact time you'll walk them through it, or get them to open it now

• Someone organized who updates notes after every call and never lets a promised callback slip

• Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection, with a quiet workspace

• Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Chat, and cloud-based calling software (CloudTalk)

• Someone who shows up on time, every shift, follows the script exactly as trained, and asks questions instead of guessing

Hiring process

Short interview plus a mock cold call AND a mock follow-up/closing call. Selected applicants start with the paid 2-week trial.

When applying, start your message with the words "READY TO CLOSE" so we know you read the full post. Then tell us:

About your cold-calling experience, especially calling U.S. businesses

About a time you had to follow up and CLOSE a sale yourself — not just set an appointment — what happened?

That you can work the trial hours (Mon–Fri 10 AM–3 PM Eastern / 10 PM–3 AM PH)

That you can move to full-time hours (Mon–Fri 8 AM–5 PM Eastern / 8 PM–5 AM PH) after the trial

title: Ai video editor
description:
# AI Video Editor Needed — High-Quality Recreation of Reference Videos (Realistic AI Drama)



We are looking for a **highly skilled AI Video Editor / AI Filmmaker** capable of recreating reference videos with exceptional visual quality using AI.



**This is NOT a standard AI video generation job.**



Our goal is to create videos that closely resemble the original references, preserving their storytelling, characters, camera angles, movements, emotions, and cinematic atmosphere.



**We do not expect a pixel-perfect recreation.** We want the final result to be as close as realistically possible to the reference, while allowing the editor to use their expertise and creativity to achieve the best possible outcome.



### What we're looking for



- **High-fidelity video recreation:** Reproduce the original scenes as closely as possible while making thoughtful creative improvements when necessary.

- **Character consistency:** Maintain consistent faces, ages, hairstyles, clothing, and physical appearances throughout.

- **Accurate storytelling:** Preserve the original storyline, key actions, emotions, and scene progression.

- **Photorealistic AI visuals:** Natural movements, realistic facial expressions, and cinematic quality.

- **German localization:** Natural German dialogue, professional voice acting using ElevenLabs, accurate lip-sync, and German subtitles.

- **Creative expertise:** Use your artistic judgment to improve transitions, visual quality, camera movements, and overall realism without losing the essence of the reference.



### Required experience



Strong experience with tools such as Kling, Seedance, Google Veo, Runway, Higgsfield, or similar advanced AI video generation platforms.



Experience with **reference-based video recreation, AI short films, cinematic storytelling, and multi-character dialogue** is highly preferred.



### Important — Own AI Tools Required



You must have access to **your own AI tools, accounts, and active subscriptions**.



We do not provide AI tools, subscriptions, or generation credits. Please include all tool-related costs in your proposed rate.



### Speed & Turnaround — Extremely Important



**We offer a premium rate because we expect exceptionally fast turnaround times without compromising quality.**



We have extensive experience working with video editors, so we understand the production process and what skilled professionals can deliver.



**For us, turnaround time is just as important as video quality.**



We're looking for editors who can work efficiently, deliver outstanding results under tight deadlines, and maintain consistent quality.



If you typically require several days to produce a short AI video, this opportunity may not be the right fit.



### Paid test



We will start with a **paid 1 minute ( 60 seconds ) test** based on an existing reference video.



The objective is to evaluate your ability to produce a visually similar, realistic, and engaging recreation while demonstrating your technical skills, creative judgment, and production speed.



Successful candidates may be offered ongoing work.



### How to apply



Please provide:



1. Your **2–3 best examples** of realistic AI-generated videos.

2. Ideally, an example showing an **original reference video alongside your AI recreation**.

3. Which AI tools you use and how you maintain character consistency.

4. Your estimated turnaround time and rate for a 30-second test, **including all AI tool costs**.



**Important:** We value visual similarity, character consistency, cinematic quality, creativity, and fast delivery equally.



We are looking for an editor who can **stay faithful to the original reference, bring their own creative expertise, and deliver exceptional results quickly without sacrificing quality.**

title: YouTube Editor | Long-Term Role with Growing Creator Channel
description:
About Us: We're a husband-and-wife content creation team sharing stories about love, relationships, purpose, kindness, travel, generosity, and living a meaningful life.



Our content includes personal vlogs, thoughtful conversations, travel adventures, and documentary-style storytelling. We have an established audience across YouTube and social media, and we're looking to build a small, dedicated creative team to help us grow.  We also do humanitarian work with a nonprofit organization bringing clean water to communities around the world. Occasionally, you may help edit content related to these humanitarian projects.



About the Role:



We're looking for a talented, reliable, and efficient YouTube Video Editor to help us consistently produce high-quality vlogs and talking head videos. Our goal is to publish 2–3 YouTube videos per week, including a weekly vlog and conversation-style videos. We already have established editing styles and detailed style guides. Initially, your priority will be learning and closely following our existing approach. As you grow into the role, we'll welcome your own creative ideas and suggestions.



Our editing style is natural, thoughtful, and understated. We're not looking for flashy transitions, excessive motion graphics, or constant sound effects. We value strong storytelling, engaging pacing, clean editing, and videos that preserve our authentic personalities.



One of our founders is a filmmaker with a particular creative sensibility for the feeling and storytelling of our videos. You'll need to be comfortable receiving detailed feedback and making revisions as you learn our style.



Your Responsibilities: 



1. Edit Long-Form YouTube Videos

Turn raw footage into engaging, polished vlogs and talking head videos.

Follow our editing style guides and established visual style.

Create strong storytelling flow, thoughtful pacing, and natural transitions.

Ensure clean audio, consistent colour, and professional-quality edits.

Submit drafts and incorporate feedback until videos meet our quality standards.



2. Incorporate Additional Footage:

Integrate B-roll, past video clips, personal photos, and other supporting footage when needed. 



3. Manage YouTube Publishing

Upload completed videos to YouTube.

Help develop engaging video titles and thumbnails, including variations for A/B testing, in our style.

Prepare video descriptions and other publishing details.

Schedule videos according to our content calendar.



4. Create Short-Form Content

Repurpose long-form videos into engaging YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other short-form videos.

Use AI tools such as Opus Clip to help identify and create clips from talking head videos.

Creatively identify compelling moments from vlogs that could work as standalone short-form content.



5. Organize Files and Deliverables

Work within our Google Workspace folder system to receive footage and deliver completed videos.

Keep raw footage, project files, and final exports organized and easy to retrieve.

Upload short-form content to our social media scheduler or shared folders for another team member to publish.

Help maintain an efficient and organized production workflow.



6. Occasional Special Projects

Assist with editing trailers, promotional videos, and other creative projects as needed.



What We're Looking For: 



Essential Skills:

Experience editing YouTube vlogs and talking head/conversation videos.

Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to identify the most compelling moments in raw footage.

Excellent pacing and attention to detail.

Proficiency with professional video editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar).

Strong audio editing and basic colour correction skills.

Ability to edit efficiently and meet agreed deadlines.

Good written English and clear communication.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage files independently.

Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to an established creative style.



Bonus Skills:

Motion Graphics & titling

Experience creating YouTube thumbnails.

Understanding of YouTube titles, audience retention, and video performance.

Experience with AI editing tools.

Experience with documentary-style or travel storytelling.

Experience with YouTube Studio and social media scheduling platforms.



Our Long-Term Vision:



We're building a reliable content production system with a clear publishing calendar, consistent deadlines, and a small team that works well together. We understand that initially, editing may take longer as you learn our style and work through revisions. Over time, however, our goal is for you to become increasingly confident, efficient, and independent — eventually delivering excellent edits that require very little revision.



We're especially looking for someone who can combine creative storytelling with speed, reliability, and a willingness to learn.

We want this to be a long-term working relationship where you can grow alongside our team, contribute your ideas, and take increasing ownership of the production process.



Hours and Compensation: 



$4/hr

Starting at about 15 hours per week, with the potential to increase as our production grows.



You'll track the time spent on each video so we can better understand our production process and plan our workload.

Flexible working hours, with clear deadlines and regular communication.



Paid editing test for shortlisted candidates.



How to Apply

Please send us:

- Your portfolio, PLUS direct Links to 2–3 of your best YouTube editing projects. We'd especially want to see vlogs and talking head videos.

- Your experience: Tell us briefly about your background in video editing and the types of content you most enjoy editing.

- Your availability: Are you currently working with other clients or employers? What do you do for them? Would you be available for approximately 15 hours per week to start?



Subject Line of your application should be:  Editor Application - [First Name Last Name]

Please use at least 7 Application Points to apply and use the word "Greece" as the last word in your application.

title: Business Development Manager | B2B Sales
description:
About Ryan Fenton PPC Ltd

Ryan Fenton PPC Ltd is a UK-based e-commerce marketing agency helping businesses grow through performance-driven marketing services, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Organic Social Media,
 marketing and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).



We work with businesses across the US, EU, Canada and UK, helping them improve their online visibility, attract the right customers, increase sales and achieve measurable growth.

We're passionate about helping e-commerce businesses grow, and we're looking for someone who would love to be part of that journey!



About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to help us find new business opportunities, build relationships with potential clients and bring new businesses to Ryan Fenton PPC Ltd.



Our E-commerce Research Specialist can help identify and research businesses that may benefit from our services. However, we also want someone who takes initiative and knows how to find opportunities independently. You'll be responsible for actively prospecting, sourcing leads and identifying potential clients rather than relying only on leads provided by the research team.



Your role will involve finding potential clients, reaching out to them, building relationships, understanding their business needs, conducting discovery calls, preparing tailored proposals, managing negotiations and ultimately bringing in new clients.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys meeting new people, building relationships and taking ownership of their work. You'll manage prospects throughout the sales process, keep the sales pipeline organised and make sure opportunities don't fall through the cracks.



Once a prospect has formally committed and the required commercial arrangements are in place, you'll coordinate the handover to our Client Success Manager, who will take care of onboarding and the ongoing client relationship.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead Management and Outreach

- Actively find, research and source potential e-commerce businesses and new business opportunities.

- Prospect and harvest leads through relevant platforms, directories, LinkedIn and other suitable channels.

- Review researched prospects provided by the E-commerce Research Specialist.

- Reach out to potential clients through calls,
 and LinkedIn.

- Build positive relationships with business owners and decision-makers.

2. Discovery and Proposals

- Conduct discovery calls to understand business needs and marketing goals.

- Recommend suitable agency services and prepare tailored proposals.

- Work with Ryan and specialists when technical input is needed.

3. Negotiation and Closing

- Follow up with prospects, address their concerns and negotiate commercial terms.

- Secure client commitments, signed agreements and initial payments.

- Prepare client handovers for the Client Success Manager.

4. Sales Pipeline and Reporting

- Keep prospect records and sales stages up to date in the CRM.

- Track sales activities, conversions and revenue.

- Provide regular progress reports and identify ways to improve sales performance.

- What We're Looking For



Essential Requirements:

- 3+ years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development or client acquisition.

- Experience managing the sales process, from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and closing.

- A track record of meeting sales targets and generating revenue.

- Experience conducting discovery calls and presenting proposals to business owners or decision-makers.

- Strong communication, consultative selling, objection-handling and negotiation skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to communicate professionally with UK/US and international clients.

- Comfortable discussing business performance, marketing goals, budgets, ROI, ROAS, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and conversion rates.

 

Preferred Experience:

- Experience selling e-commerce marketing services, particularly Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO,
 marketing, CRO and Organic Social Media.

- Previous experience working with digital marketing agencies or other service-based businesses.

- Experience working with e-commerce businesses, business owners, founders and senior decision-makers.

- Familiarity with the UK/US markets and working with international clients.

- Understanding of e-commerce and how performance marketing and paid advertising help businesses grow their online sales.



How You'll Work With the Team:

You'll work closely with our E-commerce Research Specialist, Client Success Manager and Founder. Ryan will provide business direction, service expertise and support with the technical aspects of proposals.

You'll also work with our internal team to make sure that the services we offer can be delivered effectively.



The general process will be:

- Lead Research and Prospecting: Potential prospects are identified and researched by the E-commerce Research Specialist, while you also find and pursue new business opportunities independently.

- Business Development: You handle lead harvesting, review researched prospects, qualify opportunities, conduct discovery calls, prepare proposals, manage negotiations and close new business.

- Founder Introduction: Once a prospect has formally committed, Ryan introduces himself, the agency and its approach.

- Client Success Handover: The Client Success team coordinates onboarding, manages ongoing client communication and works with the internal team to support service delivery.



What We Offer:

- Fully remote position 

- Direct collaboration with the agency founder.

- The opportunity to take ownership of business development and contribute to the agency's growth.

- Performance-based commission structure.

- The opportunity to grow alongside an expanding digital marketing agency.



Compensation: Commission-based, with a percentage earned on the initial payment received from each successfully signed client, plus a fixed incentive for every qualified sales meeting booked and attended.



Working Hours: Flexible working hours, with required availability across UK and US business hours for team coordination, prospect outreach, sales meetings and client discussions. Some flexibility in scheduling will be needed to support both markets.



How to Apply:

We'd love to learn more about you and your experience! To apply, please send us the following:

- Your CV: Include your relevant B2B sales and business development experience.

- Sales Performance: Share measurable results from your previous roles, such as revenue generated, number of deals closed, average deal value, conversion rates or sales targets achieved. Please indicate the period covered by these results.

- Introduction Video: Send us a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach your first discovery call with a prospective client interested in digital marketing services. This video is an important part of your application because we want to hear your voice and get a feel for how you speak and communicate. Please make sure your audio is clear.

- Proposal Sample: Share an example of a sales proposal you have previously prepared. Please remove any confidential client information.



Application instruction: Start your application with the word "Derbyshire", so we know you've read the full job description.

Please include all the requested information, as incomplete applications may not be considered.



We're looking for someone who can do more than generate leads. We want someone who enjoys finding new opportunities, building genuine relationships and helping e-commerce businesses grow.



If you're proactive, comfortable working independently and excited about being part of a fast- growing agency, we'd love to hear from you! 😊

title: Long-Form Video Editor

TEAM VISION

THE ROLE

You own long-form edits of 10–60+ minutes for our personal-brand clients: documentaries, interviews, educational content and VSLs. You take a script and raw footage and make the story stronger in the edit, with clean audio, the right B-roll and graphics that keep viewers watching.



You report to the Video Editor Manager and work closely with our scriptwriters, YouTube and short-form editors, and designers. Your work is judged by whether people watch it to the end and act on it.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You think about story first and effects second.

You can hold a 60-minute timeline in your head and know where it drags.

Your project files are so organized that anyone could pick them up.

You hit deadlines without being chased.

You want to grow your craft on content that drives real business results.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Full-time, fully remote work.

Edit for high-profile personal brands like Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.

A growth path inside the video team as you prove results.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Edit long-form videos of 10–60+ minutes.

Interpret scripts and strengthen the story in the edit.

Build openings and pattern interrupts that keep viewers watching through long runtimes.

Source B-roll, stock footage, music and SFX.

Own dialogue cleanup, audio balancing and basic sound design.

Add motion graphics, subtitles and lower thirds.

Use AI tools like Descript for transcripts, text-based rough cuts and audio cleanup to ship faster.

Keep project files organized in Google Drive and track work in 
.

Strong storytelling and retention instincts.

Your project files follow a standard structure any editor on the team can open and use.

You turn at least 2 long-form edits per week [confirm] at full quality.

Fully remote.

Hours. JSM standard: 6:00 AM–2:00 PM EST (6:00 PM–2:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri.

Long edits, firm deadlines. Plan your time and deliver.



HOW WE WORK

Results over hours: output counts, not time online.

Growth over perfection: ship, learn, improve.

title: Executive Assistant (Procurement & Bids)
description:
Job summary:

Be the CEO's right hand on public-sector bids. Own every deadline, document and submission, and use Claude to keep it all on track.



Meet Mosaic Effect:

Mosaic Effect is an expert-led privacy, cybersecurity and AI governance consultancy. We win most of our work through public-sector procurement: federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector tenders, supply arrangements, vendor rosters, and contract roles placed through staffing agencies.



The machinery is already built: daily portal and
 sweeps, one opportunity tracker, a stage-gated proposal process, templates, and a submission guide for every portal we use.



The role:

You are the CEO's executive assistant for everything procurement. You own the calendar and the paperwork: no deadline missed, every addendum read the day it posts, every submission in early, complete and on the record.

You take instructions and carry them through precisely. You don't write the technical substance of proposals; the CEO and our consultants do that. You make sure it comes together, gets checked and goes in on time.

You report directly to Sukhpreet Singh, CEO, and work with our consultants, staffing agencies and public-sector buyers.



Who this is for

• You follow instructions to the letter, and you ask when something is unclear instead of guessing.

• You can hold a dozen close dates in your head and never drop one.

• You read the fine print in a solicitation before anyone asks you to.

• You'd rather be done two days early than submit at the last minute.

• You already use Claude or similar AI tools every day, and you always check their work.

• You keep confidential information confidential.



What we expect from you

The work follows each bid from first sighting to final debrief.



1. Find and log opportunities (daily and weekly)

    ◦ Run the daily procurement digest (portal scrapes, bid-notice
s, agency requisitions) and log what's new in the opportunity tracker.

    ◦ Run the weekly procurement pulse across federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector sources for privacy, cybersecurity and AI-consulting work.

    ◦ Coordinate the portal assistant's weekday sweeps of login-only portals. A portal nobody reached is logged as "not checked", never "nothing found".

    ◦ Track signals that aren't bids yet: job postings that could become contracts, upcoming vendor rosters, contract-award intelligence from access-to-information requests, and loss debriefs.



2. Qualify and plan

    ◦ Prepare a one-page bid brief and a compliance matrix for each opportunity: mandatory requirements, scoring, insurance, security, certifications, references and submission method.

    ◦ Flag hard blockers early (insurance limits, WSIB, ISO 27001, clearances, certifications, vehicle-holder-only eligibility) and bring each to the CEO as a go/no-go decision.

    ◦ Build each bid's timeline backward from the close and hold the T-48-hour tripwire: everything is complete two days before close, or the CEO hears about it that day.



3. Run bid production

    ◦ Set up the bid folder from templates and keep documents versioned (v0.x drafts, v1.0 approved).

    ◦ Collect inputs on time: consultant résumés and consents, references and referee consent, corporate documents, insurance certificates, signatures and forms.

    ◦ Run the completeness check against the compliance matrix before review, and track feedback through the green-light gates.

    ◦ Send buyer questions within the question period once the CEO approves them. Download every addendum and Q&A the day it posts and update the matrix.



4. Submit and keep records

    ◦ Assemble the final package and, after CEO approval, submit through the correct portal or by
 at least 24 hours before close.

    ◦ Save proof of submission (receipts, confirmation numbers, screenshots) and file the submitted set.

    ◦ Track outcomes, request a debrief on every loss and log the lessons.



5. Agencies, rosters and registrations

    ◦ Manage staffing-agency requisitions: right-to-represent forms, résumé versions and availability confirmations, with a strict one-person, one-channel rule per requisition.

    ◦ Maintain vendor registrations and portal accounts: CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, BC Bid, Alberta Purchasing Connection, SaskTenders, Biddingo, bids&tenders and others. Track renewal dates, document fees and supplier profiles.

    ◦ Keep corporate compliance documents current and ready to attach: certificate of status, insurance certificates, WSIB/WorkSafeBC, security clearance records and supplier numbers.



6. Report

    ◦ Keep the opportunity tracker current every day: stage, close date, next action and owner.

    ◦ Send the CEO a short daily status: what closes in the next 14 days, what's blocked and what needs a decision.

    ◦ Keep an accurate work log. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.



Working with AI and Claude

AI runs a large part of our daily machinery, and Claude is the main tool you'll work with. You direct it, check it and own the result.

• Use Claude to summarize solicitations, draft compliance matrices and bid briefs, and spot mandatory requirements.

• Use Claude to draft buyer and agency
s, daily status notes and tracker updates for the CEO's approval.

• Run and supervise the AI-assisted daily digest and portal sweeps, and confirm each source was actually checked.

• Check every AI output against the source documents before it's used. AI drafts; you verify.

• Give clear, specific instructions to Claude, and improve the prompts and checklists the team relies on.



Requirements

• Exceptional organization and deadline discipline across many parallel close dates.

• Careful reading of solicitation documents: mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria, forms, and insurance and security clauses.

• Strong Word and Excel skills: tracked changes, document assembly, PDF packaging and trackers.

• Clear, concise written English for drafting
s to buyers and agencies.

• Daily, hands-on use of Claude or similar AI tools, with the habit of checking their output.

• Discretion with confidential commercial information.

• Can work EST Timezone.



Nice to have

• 2+ years in executive assistance, bid or proposal coordination, procurement administration or contract administration, ideally with Canadian public-sector tenders.

• Hands-on use of Canadian procurement portals such as CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, Ariba, Jaggaer or BC Bid.

• Familiarity with federal supply arrangements and methods of supply (TBIPS, TSPS, SBIPS, ProServices), standing offers and vendor-of-record arrangements.

• Exposure to privacy, cybersecurity or IT consulting procurement.

• Experience with staffing-agency requisitions and right-to-represent processes.



Results

• Zero missed deadlines and zero late or incomplete submissions.

• Every addendum and Q&A downloaded and reflected in the bid within one business day of posting.

• A go/no-go decision on every live opportunity within two business days of intake.

• Every submission in at least 24 hours early, with proof on file.

• A tracker that's accurate at any moment, with no "unknown" status older than a week.

• A debrief requested on every loss.



How we work

• The CEO approves anything that leaves the company: submissions, prices, signatures, declarations, and
s to buyers or agencies. You prepare each one so it only needs a yes.

• Portal logins live in a password manager. Credentials are never shared by
 or stored in documents.

• Everything lives in one shared folder, one tracker and one log.



How to apply

Interested?
 
 and attach:

• A short video introduction

• Your resume

• Your portfolio or work samples (for example, bid trackers, compliance matrices or submission packages you've managed, with confidential details removed)

**Type of Work:** Full-Time



### JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing & Growth Specialist to manage paid advertising and drive profitable growth for an innovative K-Beauty skincare and cosmetics brand.



We need someone with proven hands-on experience managing substantial advertising budgets for established, high-revenue e-commerce brands.

### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

2. Plan, allocate, and manage advertising budgets across multiple platforms.

3. Monitor ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, and overall campaign profitability.

4. Analyse advertising performance and determine where budgets should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.

5. Manage Amazon PPC campaigns, including keyword research, bidding strategies, and campaign optimisation.

6. Develop and implement strategies to improve conversions, revenue, and profitable growth.

7. Monitor campaign performance and make adjustments based on actual results.

8. Work with the creative team to test advertising content and improve campaign effectiveness.

9. Prepare performance reports covering advertising spend, revenue, and key profitability metrics.

10. Identify opportunities to scale sales while maintaining efficient advertising costs.



### REQUIREMENTS



1. Proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising for established e-commerce brands.

2. Experience with brands generating approximately $10M–$100M in annual revenue is highly preferred.

3. Strong knowledge of Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

4. Experience personally managing substantial advertising budgets.

5. Strong understanding of ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CAC, conversion rates, and profitability.

6. Ability to analyse campaign performance and make independent budget allocation decisions.

7. Proven track record of improving advertising efficiency, conversions, and profitable sales growth.

8. Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience with skincare, cosmetics, beauty, or K-Beauty brands is a plus.



### IMPORTANT – APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



**To be considered, please include the following with your CV:**



**1. BRAND NAMES AND DIRECT STORE LINKS (REQUIRED)**



Provide the names of brands for which you have personally managed advertising campaigns, along with direct links to their Amazon storefronts, Shopify websites, or other active sales pages.



**2. ANNUAL SALES REVENUE**



State the approximate annual revenue in USD of each brand during your involvement, particularly if you have worked with brands generating $10M or more annually.



**3. ADVERTISING BUDGETS MANAGED**



Specify the approximate monthly or annual advertising budgets you personally managed, including the platforms involved.



**4. YOUR SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES**

**5. ACTUAL CAMPAIGN RESULTS AND SUPPORTING EVIDENCE**

- ROAS or ACOS improvements

- Revenue or sales growth

- Reduction in customer acquisition costs

- Improvements in advertising efficiency or profitability

- Successful campaign scaling



Supporting evidence, such as redacted advertising dashboard screenshots, performance reports, or case studies, is strongly preferred. Confidential information may be hidden.



**6. EMPLOYMENT DATES**



Include how long you worked with each brand and which advertising platforms you managed during that period.



### PLEASE NOTE



**Applications without brand names, direct store links, advertising budget details, and clear examples of actual campaign results will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who has already managed advertising at scale and can make informed decisions based on financial performance, not just impressions, clicks, or engagement.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to provide additional information to verify their experience.



### SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Performance Marketing | Amazon PPC | Google Ads | Meta Ads | TikTok Ads

description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. We have a lot to tell: an Anthropic partnership, real client results and our own AI products. We are hiring someone to make sure the right people hear it.

Location and type



- Remote

- Interest in AI and software

AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to draft posts, research companies, make videos or analyze campaign results, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into marketing.

2. Content that worked: Walk us through a LinkedIn post or campaign you made that performed well. Why do you think it worked?

3. A campaign that didn't work: Tell us about a post, campaign or A/B test that didn't perform. How did you find out, and what did you change?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in your marketing work today? How do you keep AI-written content from sounding generic?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

Step 2: Submit your application

What happens next

description:
We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):
