title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Shopify Developer (Expert Level): Migration Project + Optional Long-Term Role
description:
Strong Brands United Corp (SBU Corp)

Remote | Full-time project (1–2 months), with an optional long-term role after

ABOUT US

Strong Brands United builds and scales e-commerce brands across multiple channels and markets, including the EU. We also build online shops for our agency clients.



PHASE 1: MIGRATION PROJECT (Full-time, 1–2 months)

We are moving all our webshops to Shopify. We start with a test project on one small shop, then migrate our main shops. Target: everything live by the end of December.



You will:

- Migrate products, customers, and orders, set up URL redirects, and preserve SEO and Google rankings

- Use the Shopify Admin GraphQL API for bulk operations, while handling rate limits properly

- Build and maintain ERP/order integrations for orders, stock levels, and shipping status

- Set up Shopify Markets for EU and international selling

- Work closely with our full-stack developer to make sure our product data quality is perfect



PHASE 2: OPTIONAL LONG-TERM ROLE

If you want to continue after the migration, the role splits into two halves:

- Half-time Shop Manager for our own shops, working under our technical lead: banners and campaigns, making sure our products are found in AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.), keeping all products displayed perfectly, analyzing how customers click and buy, and building new shops

- Half-time Shopify builds for our agency clients



MUST-HAVES

- 3+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience

- Proven Shopify migrations with redirects and SEO preserved

- Strong experience with the Shopify Admin GraphQL API, including bulk operations and rate limits

- Experience integrating Shopify with ERP, inventory, or fulfillment systems

- Able to work full-time during the migration project

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with JTL-Wawi (strong plus)

- Experience with AI search visibility, CRO, and analytics (GA4, heatmaps)

- Shopify Plus experience

- German language skills



AVAILABILITY (for hourly work)

- At least 2 working hours for us within every 12–24 hours, or fixed hours on fixed days

- A backup in place for critical processes, so nothing stops if you are unavailable



RATE

Please state your own rate. We expect honest applications and do not share a budget.



HOW TO APPLY

Text-only messages will not be considered. Please send a proper application including:

1. Your CV (PDF)

2. Links to live Shopify stores you built yourself

3. One migration you completed (store link plus a short description of what you did)

4. Your rate

5. Your earliest start date

6. Your available hours per week

title: CPA Accountant – UK Clients (Remote, Full-Time Contract)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated, PRC-licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to support our UK-based clients as a full-time, long-term independent contractor.

Because you will handle confidential client financial data, during the engagement you must not take on accounting, bookkeeping or tax work for other accounting firms or for any of our clients. You must also be fully available during the agreed hours. Please tell us about any other ongoing work when you apply.

You will provide your own professional home office setup, including a suitable computer or laptop, a reliable high-speed internet connection, and backup internet and power. To protect client data, screen sharing, activity-monitoring software and webcam monitoring will be used during working hours. Full details are set out in your agreement with us.

This is a long-term opportunity, with scope for increased pay and greater responsibility as our international team grows.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Financial Administration

• Record and maintain day-to-day financial transactions accurately.

• Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

• Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations.

• Ensure transactions are accurately recorded in supplier, customer, and general ledgers.

• Maintain accounting records up to trial balance stage.

Financial Reporting & Review

• Prepare year-end and statutory accounts for UK companies under FRS 102 / FRS 105.

• Prepare management accounts and reports.

• Lead month-end and year-end accounting processes.

• Review bookkeeping prepared by other team members and resolve discrepancies.

• Ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.

Tax & Compliance

• Prepare VAT returns (Making Tax Digital) for review and submission.

• Prepare corporation tax and self-assessment computations and supporting schedules for review.

• Support compliance with HMRC and Companies House requirements.

• Maintain accurate records for audit and regulatory purposes.

Payroll Administration

• Process payroll accurately and on time, including preparing RTI submissions.

• Assist with workplace (auto-enrolment) pension administration and related reporting.

General Support

• Respond to technical accounting queries from the team.

• Assist with additional accounting and bookkeeping tasks as agreed.

________________________________________

Qualifications & Experience

Essential Requirements

• Active Philippine CPA licence (PRC) – licence number required with your application

• Minimum of 2 years' accounting experience, including preparing financial statements

• Strong understanding of accounting principles (PFRS/IFRS); knowledge of UK GAAP (FRS 102/105) is an advantage

• Experience preparing financial reports and reconciliations

• Advanced numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Skills

• Experience with UK clients (VAT, PAYE/RTI, Corporation Tax, Self-Assessment) – preferred, but training on UK requirements can be provided

• Experience using Xero and/or QuickBooks (training can be provided); Xero or QuickBooks certification is a plus

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications

• Experience with payroll and tax compliance processes

• Knowledge of financial data analysis and reporting

Technical Requirements

• Computer or laptop with at least an Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 processor and 16GB RAM (or equivalent)

• Internet connection of at least 25 Mbps

• Backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and a UPS or backup power supply

• Quiet, private workspace, headset and webcam

________________________________________

Key Competencies

We're looking for someone who demonstrates:

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong organisational and time-management skills

• Professional integrity and confidentiality

• Effective problem-solving abilities

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Commitment to meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality work

________________________________________

What We Offer

• Monthly pay of PHP 50,000 – 70,000 depending on experience, paid in PHP via Wise (we cover the transfer fees)

• 22 paid days off per year: the 12 Philippine regular national holidays plus 10 additional days

• 13th-month bonus

• HMO medical cover after 12 months' continuous service

• Long-term engagement following successful completion of the trial period

• Scope for greater responsibility and increased pay

• Fully remote work arrangement

• Supportive and collaborative team environment

________________________________________

Working Schedule

• 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM London time, Monday to Friday, including a 1-hour break

• Philippine time: 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM from late October to late March, and 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM from late March to late October (when UK clocks change)

________________________________________

How to Apply

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your application with the subject line "UK-CPA-2026". Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed. Please include:

1. Confirmation that you are available 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM London time (see Philippine times above).

2. Your PRC CPA licence number.

3. Your expected monthly pay within the advertised range.

4. Your earliest available start date.

5. Your current work status, including any other clients or employers you currently work with.

6. Confirmation that you will stop any other accounting, bookkeeping or tax work for other firms before starting with us.

7. A screenshot of a recent internet speed test, and details of your backup internet and power arrangements.

8. An updated copy of your CV/Resume.

________________________________________

Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a practical accounting skills test and a video interview. Before starting, successful candidates will need to provide references and sign an agreement covering confidentiality, data protection and intellectual property. An NBI clearance may also be requested.

________________________________________

Join Our Team

If you are a PRC-licensed CPA with strong accounting expertise, excellent attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality financial work, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join a growing organisation that values professionalism, integrity, and continuous development.

_________________________________________



Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

title: Founder Led Content Video Editor
description:
Not just another "clipping" job 



If you love short form content and get frustrated seeing mass produced clips that don't understand psychology, story telling and creating emotion ... this is for you. 



We're looking for someone who loves searching through content for the part that tells a story, the hook that most people don't see and can craft a reel that makes people actually feel something. Someone who wants to create content they're actually proud of. 



A good clip is the difference between a great conversation nobody watches and content that builds someone's business, brand and community and that is what we create. 



About Project C



After landing every podcast we've ever launched on the top charts, and working with some of Australia's favourite creators, we learned exactly what separates good content from content that actually builds your business, brand and community.



We spent years searching for a studio that understood what creators need ... then we stopped searching and started building.



We wanted to build a space that inspired every person who walked in the door, that encouraged better conversation and didn't just make you sound great but make you look and feel your best as well.

The studio has Netflix Approved 4K Cameras, the Microphones the best podcasters in the world use, lighting that makes you look like you've slept 10+ hours (even when you've only slept 4) and a team that are obsessed with helping you create content you can't wait to share.



About You.



You love social media, learning the algorthims and creating content 

You edit for retention and engagement. You understand pace, tension, and why people keep watching instead of swiping.

You check your work thoroughly

You obsess over the small details. Framing, eye levels, making sure everything is optimised for the platform it is posted on and no typos

You are proactive. If you think we should change a process or there is a better way to film or feedback a host needs to hear you tell us. 

You will always met a deadline or proactively tell us if there are ever any issues 

You love creating processes and structures that make everyones lives easier

You are proactive - if you see a way for something to be done better ... you do it.

You take feedback and come back sharper. You are not precious about a cut, you are precious about the result.

You have worked with a studio or agency before on high volume work 

You want to grow with a business and have opportunities to learn and upskill

You are an excellent communicator.

BONUS - You love AI and are already building and learning to use AI tools to take your editing process to the next level 





Our Non-Negotiables



You are not an agency and you are not outsourcing the edit to someone else. You may have the opportunity to grow a team under you later, but we are hiring one editor who is excited to grow with us.

Excellent communication. If a deadline is going to be missed, you are stuck, or you need a better brief, you tell us ASAP.

You never hide problems.

You hit deadlines. 

You are proactive and make calls without being told, but you ask questions rather than guessing.



What you will own



- Cutting the podcasts filmed at our studio into finished long-form episodes that hold attention start to finish.

- Founder-led content. Taking a client's raw footage and shaping it into clips, brand pieces and story-driven edits that make them look like the authority they are.

- Short-form built for reach. Hooks, pacing, captions and clips engineered to be watched, shared and saved.

- Building your own edit templates, presets and SOPs (with AI to assist) so the work gets faster and more consistent over time.



There are opportunities for additional work in thumbnails, carousel creation, or building AI editing workflows to fill additional hours. Tell us what you love, and if it is the right fit we would love to train you and get you building other skills too.



What we offer

- Flexible working hours with a requirement to be available for some crossover in Australian business hours, 9am to 5pm AEST.

- Opportunity for growth in salary, skills and opportunity 

- Training in the AI production systems we are building. That skill will be worth more to you in three years than this job pays today.

- A long-term seat. We are not filling a gap. We are hiring the editor who shapes how Project C's content looks long term. 



Must haves



- Two or more years editing video, ideally podcast, social or branded content for a Western audience.

- A showreel or portfolio. This one is non-negotiable: we want to see both short-form clips and at least one longer, story-driven edit.

- Fluent in editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Both is a bonus. CapCut, Descript, After Effects and 
 are all a plus.

- Excellent written English.

- Reliable power, internet and a computer that can handle 4K video files, with a backup plan. You will be moving large video files, so great internet is a must.

- Full or part time, tell us what you are after.

- Extra points for colour grading, sound, motion graphics, thumbnail design, or experience editing for founder and creator brands.



How to apply



Fill out this form

title: Australian Finance Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Finance Manager to oversee financial operations, financial reporting, management accounting, and cost accounting across multiple entities.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing month-end closing activities, supporting budgeting and forecasting, monitoring cash flow, and providing meaningful financial analysis to management.



Key Responsibilities



1. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close

- Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.

- Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and general ledger reconciliations.

- Maintain accurate balance sheets and resolve outstanding reconciliation items.

- Handle intercompany transactions, multi-entity accounting, and consolidations.

- Manage fixed assets, depreciation, and other balance sheet accounts.

- Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, including AASB.

- Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules for management and external audits.



2. Day-to-Day Finance Operations

- Oversee and perform accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger activities.

- Manage supplier payments, customer receipts, expense transactions, and banking activities.

- Handle multi-currency transactions and foreign exchange reconciliations.

- Monitor outstanding receivables, collections, and debtor management.

- Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper transaction processing and documentation.



3. Management Accounting & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly management reports, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.

- Analyse financial performance against budgets, forecasts, and prior periods.

- Provide variance analysis, financial commentary, and actionable insights to management.

- Prepare cost-centre and profit-centre reporting, including profitability and margin analysis.

- Support financial planning, budgeting, and rolling forecasts.

- Monitor financial performance and identify opportunities for operational and financial improvements.



4. Cost Accounting, Revenue & Financial Controls

- Monitor cost allocations, operating expenses, and profitability across business activities.

- Perform cost accounting, including inventory valuation, standard costing, COGS, and variance analysis where applicable.

- Review revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and revenue-related reconciliations.

- Analyse recurring revenue, subscription-based metrics, and other operational KPIs where applicable.

- Ensure appropriate accounting controls, transaction cut-offs, and financial reporting procedures.

- Identify accounting discrepancies and implement corrective actions.



5. Cash Flow Management & Forecasting

- Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts and monitor short-term and long-term liquidity.

- Analyse cash inflows, outflows, working capital, and funding requirements.

- Support annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and scenario analysis.

- Identify potential cash flow risks and communicate findings to management.

- Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decisions.



6. Team Leadership & Process Improvement

- Supervise and review the work of accounting and finance team members.

- Set priorities, monitor deliverables, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

- Review financial reports and reconciliations before management approval.

- Develop and maintain accounting procedures, documentation, and internal controls.

- Improve accounting workflows, reporting efficiency, and automation opportunities.

- Coordinate with finance teams and stakeholders across different entities and locations.



Qualifications & Experience



- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

- CPA,

- At least 5 years of relevant accounting and finance experience.

- Strong experience in financial accounting, management accounting, and month-end close.

- Hands-on experience with AP, AR, general ledger, reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.

- Strong background in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial analysis.

- Experience supporting Australian businesses or clients.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Xero and/or ERP systems.

- Excellent English communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with NetSuite or other ERP platforms.

- Familiarity with Australian Accounting Standards (AASB), GST, and BAS.

- Experience with Power BI or financial reporting and automation tools.



Work Arrangement & Benefits:

- Work Setup: 100% remote / Work-from-Home (WFH)

- Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Work Schedule: Australian business hours

- 13th Month Pay: Provided annually

- Health Benefits: HMO coverage

- Salary: NO salary deductions; full agreed compensation will be received



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your resume and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Paid test: use AI to fix an electrical contractor's problem (construction background)
description:
We build custom apps for Australian electrical and air-con contractors, with AI doing the coding. We're looking for construction people (estimators, QS, site or project engineers, drafters) who can turn a contractor's words into a working app using AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.

When a builder asks for extra work on site, the boys write it on a scrap of paper, usually with no photos, so he can't prove it or bill it. 4. Send a 1-minute voice note explaining something about construction you've learnt that can't be searched with AI. We'll properly research whatever you say.



There is also a short design test (5 screens, about 10 minutes). We only send it to people who ask, so ask for it in your application.

title: Procurement & Planning Coordinator
description:
The Company

Nutriseed is on a mission to make healthy living easy. Our philosophy is simple: every mouthful of food should be both nourishing and delicious. We have spent years creating and curating the highest-quality health foods, ensuring they are free from hidden sugars, additives, and unnecessary processing while remaining affordable and accessible.

As a privately owned, self-funded, and profitable direct-to-consumer brand, Nutriseed has achieved double-digit year-on-year growth, and we’re scaling fast. With ambitious plans to double our revenue and likely our team size within the next three years, we are looking for a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to bring structure, clarity, and control to our stock and supply.



This is a critical role in making sure stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data. The ideal candidate will embody and champion our core values:



🔹 We Always Deliver – Taking ownership and ensuring high standards in everything we do.

🔹 We Have a Growth Mindset – Continuously learning, adapting, and improving.

🔹 We Are Accountable – Taking responsibility for actions and outcomes.

🔹 We Care – Genuinely caring about our team, customers, and mission.



Do you have the planning skills, supplier experience, and attention to detail to keep a fast-growing brand in stock?

If so, read on: this could be the opportunity for you.



The Opportunity

Nutriseed is seeking a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to own demand planning, purchasing and supplier coordination, and the accuracy of the data and systems behind them, with bounded, structured support to the Founder.

This role is critical in ensuring stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data.



What We Need From Our Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator

Demand & Supply Planning (Primary Responsibility)

Own the forecasting and planning of stock to ensure smooth operations and minimise risk.

Key responsibilities:

Build and maintain weekly/ monthly/ quarterly and annual demand forecasts (SKU level)

Translate forecasts into production requirements

Turn forecasts and stock cover into purchase quantities and order dates, allowing for minimum order quantities and manufacturing and freight lead times

Monitor stock levels, coverage, and risks (OOS / overstock)

Work closely with Operations to align production planning

Flag risks early and propose solutions



Success looks like:

No unexpected stockouts

Reduced waste / overproduction

Clear forward visibility of stock requirements

Procurement & Supplier Coordination (Primary Responsibility)

Own purchasing and day-to-day supplier coordination, so the right stock is ordered on the right terms and arrives when needed.



Key responsibilities:

Lead supplier coordination and negotiation, including with manufacturers in China: pricing, payment terms and delivery commitments, within agreed approval limits

Raise and manage approved purchase orders, and track them through production, quality checks, freight/import and receipt, working with the teams responsible for each stage

Keep purchasing records in Unleashed accurate, including order status, receipts and reconciliation with the warehouse

Give Finance visibility of deposits, balances and due dates when orders are committed and whenever plans change



Success looks like:

Purchase orders placed on time and in the right quantities

Suppliers deliver against agreed commitments, with issues flagged early

Accurate, up-to-date purchasing records

Finance has early, accurate visibility of supplier payments

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure systems are working efficiently and processes are clearly defined.

Key responsibilities:

Support and maintain integrations (Shopify, Unleashed, etc.)

Identify inefficiencies in current workflows

Document and improve processes

Work with team members to implement better systems

Success looks like:

Fewer operational errors

Clear, documented processes

Improved efficiency across teams

Key KPIs

Forecast accuracy

Stock availability (minimising stockouts)

Supplier delivery performance against agreed commitments

Accuracy of purchasing records and commitments, including Finance visibility

Reporting accuracy and timeliness

Reduction in system/data errors

Process improvements implemented



Your Role and Its Boundaries

To ensure focus and sustainability, the following are not part of this role:

Fulfilment or dispatch ownership

Factory or production leadership, or sign-off of food quality

Budget, P&L or spending authority

Marketing ownership

Wider cross-functional project management; routine supplier, purchasing and stock coordination stays with this role

General executive-assistant duties for the Founder

Ad hoc/reactive tasks from multiple team members

Constant task-switching or firefighting

Undefined “catch-all” responsibilities

title: Senior FP&A & Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Senior FP&A & Business Intelligence Analyst

Company: EVORETRO

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 4–7+ Years



ABOUT EVORETRO



EVORETRO is a growing international e-commerce company specializing in collectible protection, storage, and display products, including trading card protection, graded card accessories, binders, and other collectibles.



We operate across multiple international markets and sell through various channels, including Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, distributors, and B2B partnerships.



As our business continues to expand, we are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Senior FP&A & Business Intelligence Analyst who can transform financial, inventory, sales, and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable business recommendations.



This is not a traditional accounting or bookkeeping position.



We are looking for someone who understands how financial data connects to business performance and can help management make better decisions regarding cash flow, inventory investments, profitability, and strategic projects.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Senior FP&A & Business Intelligence Analyst will work closely with company management to monitor financial performance, develop forecasts, identify business risks, and evaluate opportunities for growth.



The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, analyzing large datasets, building financial models, and presenting clear recommendations to senior management.



You should be someone who can look at the numbers and answer questions such as:



- Where is the company investing too much cash?

- Which products are generating the highest and lowest margins?

- Which inventory should we reorder, reduce, delay, or discontinue?

- Are our current purchasing decisions financially sustainable?

- Which sales channels, customers, and territories are most profitable?

- Which business projects deserve additional investment?

- What are the company's biggest financial and operational risks?

- What actions should management prioritize based on the data?



We want someone who does more than prepare spreadsheets. We want someone who can interpret financial information, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and recommend what the business should do next.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Financial Planning, Cash Flow & Forecasting



- Develop and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.

- Prepare monthly and annual financial forecasts.

- Monitor actual financial performance against budgets and forecasts.

- Identify potential cash flow shortages, working capital constraints, and financial risks.

- Analyze the financial impact of inventory purchases, supplier payments, accounts receivable, and major business expenses.

- Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess different business conditions.

- Recommend actions to improve cash flow management and working capital efficiency.

- Provide management with regular financial updates and forward-looking projections.



2. Inventory & Working Capital Analytics



- Analyze inventory performance by SKU, product category, warehouse, and territory.

- Monitor inventory turnover, weeks of supply, stock availability, and inventory aging.

- Identify slow-moving inventory, dead stock, overstock, and potential stockout risks.

- Review inventory in transit, open purchase orders, and upcoming supplier commitments.

- Evaluate inventory purchasing decisions based on demand, sales trends, margins, and cash availability.

- Recommend which products should be reordered, reduced, delayed, liquidated, or discontinued.

- Identify opportunities to improve inventory investment and reduce unnecessary working capital.

- Collaborate with Supply Chain and Sales teams to improve demand planning and purchasing decisions.



3. Product & Business Profitability Analysis



- Analyze profitability across individual SKUs, product categories, customers, distributors, retailers, territories, countries, and sales channels.

- Evaluate gross profit, contribution margins, operating expenses, and overall business performance.

- Identify products and channels with declining margins or unusually high operating costs.

- Analyze marketplace fees, shipping expenses, fulfillment costs, and other expenses affecting profitability.

- Identify opportunities to improve pricing, margins, and cost efficiency.

- Provide recommendations on products, customers, and sales channels that deserve greater investment or operational attention.



4. Strategic Project & Investment Analysis



EVORETRO regularly evaluates new products, markets, distributors, trade shows, warehouses, and other business opportunities.



The analyst will:



- Develop financial business cases for proposed projects and investments.

- Evaluate expected revenue, gross profit, EBITDA impact, cash requirements, and working capital needs.

- Calculate return on investment (ROI) and payback periods.

- Perform financial scenario analysis to evaluate potential risks and returns.

- Compare competing projects based on financial impact, investment requirements, and business priorities.

- Recommend whether projects should proceed, be placed on hold, or be discontinued.

- Maintain a project prioritization dashboard for management.

- Present clear, data-supported investment recommendations.



5. Business Intelligence & Management Reporting



- Develop and maintain financial and operational dashboards using Power BI, Excel, Power Query, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

- Consolidate data from financial, inventory, sales, and operational systems.

- Develop executive dashboards that highlight key performance indicators, financial trends, and business exceptions.

- Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.

- Monitor important KPIs, including:

  - Revenue and net sales

  - Gross profit and gross margin

  - EBITDA and operating expenses

  - Cash position and cash flow projections

  - Inventory turnover and weeks of supply

  - Slow-moving and excess inventory

  - Product and channel profitability

  - Working capital requirements

  - Budget versus actual performance

- Translate complex financial information into clear findings and actionable recommendations.

- Ensure management receives accurate, relevant, and timely financial insights.



6. AI, Automation & Process Improvement



We value professionals who understand how technology and AI can improve financial analysis and business intelligence.



The successful candidate will:



- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot to support financial analysis and reporting.

- Identify opportunities to automate recurring financial reports and data consolidation.

- Improve existing forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes.

- Automate data cleaning, variance analysis, and management summaries where appropriate.

- Explore ways to integrate financial and operational data from different business systems.

- Reduce manual reporting work while improving accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making speed.



7. Weekly Executive Financial Reporting



The analyst will prepare a concise weekly financial update for company leadership covering:



A. Cash Position

- Current cash position

- 13-week cash flow forecast

- Upcoming financial commitments

- Potential cash flow risks



B. Inventory Performance

- Overstock and dead stock

- Slow-moving inventory

- Stockout risks

- Upcoming purchasing requirements

- Recommended purchasing adjustments



C. Business Performance

- Sales and revenue trends

- Gross profit and margins

- Product and channel profitability

- Significant financial variances



D. Strategic Projects

- Projects requiring investment

- Expected financial returns

- ROI and payback estimates

- Project prioritization



E. Management Recommendations

- Key financial risks requiring attention

- Opportunities to improve profitability

- Three or more priority actions or decisions recommended to management, where applicable



The objective is not to produce more reports. The objective is to help management make faster, more informed, and financially sound business decisions.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:



- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accountancy, Economics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.

- At least 4–7 years of relevant professional experience in FP&A, financial analysis, business intelligence, or financial planning.

- Strong practical experience in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.

- Experience developing and maintaining cash flow forecasts, preferably rolling 13-week forecasts.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and financial modeling.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.

- Strong understanding of profitability analysis, gross margins, working capital, and financial performance.

- Experience analyzing large datasets and consolidating information from multiple business systems.

- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to explain complex financial information in a clear and practical manner.

- Ability to work independently and communicate financial recommendations to senior management.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience in one or more of the following industries or areas is highly desirable:



- E-commerce and online retail

- Distribution and wholesale

- Retail and consumer products

- Manufacturing

- Inventory-heavy businesses

- Supply chain and demand planning

- Working capital management

- Financial and operational analytics



Additional technical advantages:



- Experience with inventory management or ERP systems such as Cin7.

- Familiarity with Amazon, Shopify, eBay, and Walmart business data.

- Knowledge of SQL and database management.

- Experience using Python for financial analysis and automation.

- Experience with AI-assisted financial analysis and reporting.

- Experience integrating financial and operational data across multiple platforms.



CPA certification is an advantage but is NOT required.



We value practical FP&A experience, financial modeling capabilities, analytical thinking, and commercial judgment more than accounting credentials alone.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly analytical and naturally curious about business performance.

- Commercially minded and able to connect financial results with operational decisions.

- Proactive in identifying financial risks and improvement opportunities.

- Comfortable challenging assumptions and questioning existing processes.

- Independent and capable of managing responsibilities without constant supervision.

- Detail-oriented but able to see the bigger business picture.

- Confident in communicating findings and recommendations to senior management.

- Interested in using technology and AI to improve business processes.



You should be able to explain not only what happened financially, but also why it happened, what it means for the business, and what management should do next.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in this role will be measured by the candidate's ability to:



- Maintain reliable and actionable financial forecasts.

- Identify potential cash flow and working capital risks early.

- Improve visibility into inventory performance and purchasing decisions.

- Provide accurate product, customer, and channel profitability analysis.

- Develop useful financial dashboards and management reports.

- Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve margins.

- Evaluate business investments using sound financial analysis.

- Provide practical recommendations that support better management decisions.

- Improve reporting efficiency through automation and process improvements.



HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will undergo the following assessment process:



1. Initial Application Screening



We will review relevant FP&A experience, financial modeling skills, forecasting experience, analytical capabilities, and technical proficiency.



2. Initial Interview



Qualified candidates will be interviewed to assess their professional background, technical knowledge, communication skills, and ability to work independently.



3. Practical Business Case Assessment



Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical business case involving sample company data, including:



- Sales and revenue data

- Inventory records

- Open purchase orders

- Cash flow information

- Product profitability

- Potential business investments



Candidates will be asked to identify financial and inventory risks, evaluate purchasing decisions, analyze profitability, prioritize investments, and present recommendations to management.



4. Final Management Interview



Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to a final interview with company management.

title: Senior AI Creative Producer & Editor – Team Lead
description:
# Senior AI Creative Producer & Editor – Team Lead (Full-Time)



**DTC Performance Marketing | Hands-On Production | AI Systems | Team Leadership**



## The Role



We're looking for a highly experienced, hands-on **Senior AI Creative Producer & Editor** to lead creative production across our DTC eCommerce brands.



This is a hybrid role combining **high-level video editing, AI creative production, team leadership, and production systems development.**



You'll personally produce and edit high-performing paid-social ads while mentoring junior editors, reviewing their work, and implementing AI-powered workflows to make our entire operation faster, more organized, and more scalable.



We're looking for someone who has worked with established 7–8 figure DTC brands, understands what makes performance creatives convert, and has proven experience leading other creative professionals.



**We don't want a manager who stopped editing. We want an exceptional producer and editor who can also lead, teach, and build systems.**



## What You'll Do



### 1. Hands-On Creative Production & Editing



- Personally produce and edit high-performing direct-response ads for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

- Turn scripts, UGC, raw footage, and AI-generated assets into compelling, conversion-focused video ads.

- Handle complex and high-priority creative projects from concept to final export.

- Produce AI-generated b-roll, product visuals, avatars, voiceovers, lip-sync, and realistic video scenes.

- Develop hook variations, alternate bodies, CTAs, and new editing approaches for creative testing.

- Bring strong creative judgment to pacing, visual storytelling, motion graphics, sound design, and overall production quality.

- Proactively suggest better visual executions when scripts or creative briefs could be improved.



### 2. Lead & Mentor Junior Editors



- Guide, mentor, and provide daily feedback to junior video editors and AI creative operators.

- Review their work, maintain high quality standards, and help them improve their editing and AI production skills.

- Delegate projects based on complexity, capacity, and individual strengths.

- Establish editing standards, reusable templates, and production guidelines.

- Lead by example through your own creative work.

- Help build a team capable of producing more high-quality ads with less supervision.



### 3. Build & Implement AI Production Systems



- Identify, test, and implement AI tools that improve creative quality and production efficiency.

- Develop repeatable workflows for AI-generated footage, product scenes, UGC, avatars, voiceovers, and post-production.

- Create practical SOPs, prompt libraries, production templates, and automation workflows.

- Integrate AI tools into the team's daily operations.

- Organize assets, projects, naming conventions, and production pipelines.

- Reduce repetitive work, remove production bottlenecks, and improve turnaround times.

- Continuously evaluate new AI technology and introduce meaningful improvements.



**We need someone who doesn't just use AI personally but knows how to make an entire creative team better with it.**



### 4. Collaborate on Performance Creative



- Work closely with our Creative Strategist and Creative Director to execute creative concepts and testing plans.

- Understand direct-response fundamentals: hooks, pattern interrupts, retention, pacing, offers, and CTAs.

- Analyze performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS.

- Improve creative execution based on performance data and viewer drop-off.

- Study top-performing competitor ads and translate effective production techniques into original creatives.

- Help develop and iterate winning formats that can be scaled across multiple brands.



## What We're Looking For



### Required Experience



- **5+ years** of professional video editing and creative production experience.

- **2+ years** of experience leading, supervising, or mentoring creative team members.

- Proven history working with established **7–8 figure DTC/eCommerce brands** or leading performance creative agencies.

- Strong portfolio of real paid-social creatives, ideally with measurable performance results.

- Advanced hands-on video editing skills, including complex edits, storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, and sound design.

- Extensive practical experience with AI video and image generation.

- Experience building and improving creative production workflows, SOPs, and team processes.

- Strong understanding of performance advertising and direct-response marketing.

- Ability to balance personal creative output with leadership responsibilities.

- Excellent organization, communication, and ownership.



### AI & Technical Skills



Strong practical knowledge of leading tools, including:



- **Video generation:** Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Hailuo, Wan

- **Image generation:** Nano Banana, Flux, GPT Image

- **Avatars, voice & lip-sync:** HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Kling Avatar, InfiniTalk

- **Enhancement:** Topaz, AI upscaling, scene extensions, background removal

- **AI workflows:** fal.ai, kie.ai, Higgsfield, n8n, Make, API-based integrations

- **Editing:** Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut



You don't need to have used every tool listed. What matters is your ability to master new technology quickly and implement it effectively.



## Who You Are



**A Maker First:** You love creating and editing. You want to remain actively involved in production, not spend your entire day managing projects.



**A Natural Leader:** You can teach, guide, and elevate other editors without micromanaging them.



**A Systems Thinker:** You don't just solve today's production problem. You build a repeatable solution that prevents it from happening again.



**AI-Driven:** You actively experiment with emerging AI tools and understand how to turn them into practical workflows.



**Performance-Focused:** You care about how an ad performs, not just how polished it looks.



**Highly Accountable:** You take ownership of deadlines, production quality, and your team's output.



## Nice to Have



- Experience with jewelry, wedding, fashion, supplements, or health and wellness brands.

- Experience producing ads for DTC brands spending $100K+/month on paid social.

- Experience managing remote video editing teams.

- Experience building automated AI production pipelines.

- Advanced motion graphics and kinetic typography.

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Atria, Motion, or similar creative analytics tools.



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will:



- Personally deliver high-quality, performance-focused video creatives.

- Take an active leadership role in guiding and developing our junior editors.

- Establish consistent production standards and clear review processes.

- Implement AI workflows that improve production speed and creative capabilities.

- Build reusable templates, prompt libraries, and organized asset systems.

- Increase the team's creative output without sacrificing quality.

- Become our go-to expert for complex creative production and AI execution.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. **Portfolio:** Your best DTC performance ads that you personally edited or produced.

2. **Track Record:** Brands you've worked with, your responsibilities, and any measurable creative results.

3. **Leadership Experience:** How many editors you've managed or mentored and what your role involved.

4. **AI Production Examples:** Real examples of AI-generated creatives and workflows you've developed.

5. **Systems Experience:** An example of a production workflow or process you've implemented that improved efficiency or quality.



We're looking for someone who can demonstrate **exceptional hands-on creative skills, proven leadership experience, and the ability to build scalable AI production systems.**

title: L2 Senior Support & Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role: 



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented L2 Senior Support & Operations Specialist to handle complex customer and operational cases involving payments, crypto transactions, account activity, and fund movement.



The role requires strong operational judgment, investigation skills, and the ability to use sensitive internal tools safely. You will work across multiple systems and providers to identify issues, assess risks, and determine the appropriate resolution or escalation.



The L2 Senior Support & Operations Specialist will handle escalated cases that require critical thinking, careful investigation, and a strong understanding of payments, crypto transactions, customer account activity, and operational risk.



Key Responsibilities



- Investigate escalated payment, crypto, account, and transaction-related cases

- Trace fund movement across internal systems, providers, wallets, and payment flows

title: Sports Card Sourcing Specialist - Ebay Auctions
description:
Company: Pinnacle Card Shop – Australia

Location: (Work From Home)

Employment: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week

Salary: Up to AUD $8/hour + Performance-Based Bonuses (Negotiable Based on Experience)



About Us



Pinnacle Card Shop is an Australian sports-card business specialising in trading cards, sealed products, live breaks and online sales.



We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our team as a **Sports Card Sourcing Specialist**.



Your primary responsibility will be identifying and purchasing undervalued sports cards through eBay auctions, helping us acquire quality inventory at competitive prices.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys sports, understands trading cards and wants to develop their skills within a growing business.



## Key Responsibilities



- Research sports-card auctions on eBay to identify potential buying opportunities.

- Analyse recent sales data using eBay sold listings, 130point, Card Ladder and other relevant research tools.

- Accurately identify cards, including variations, parallels, numbered cards, autographs, rookie cards and graded cards.

- Determine realistic market values and calculate maximum purchase prices based on our sourcing guidelines.

- Place bids on suitable auctions in accordance with approved budgets and purchasing procedures.

- Identify reliable sellers and assess card condition, authenticity concerns and potential risks.

- Maintain accurate records of researched auctions, bids, purchases and estimated margins.

- Monitor auction results and track sourcing performance.

- Communicate regularly with management about opportunities, results and any issues.



## What We're Looking For



**Preferred Qualifications:**



- Existing knowledge of sports trading cards, particularly NBA, soccer and a small amount of NFL

- Experience buying or selling trading cards on eBay.

- Familiarity with eBay sold listings, and Card Ladder

- Previous experience in product sourcing, e-commerce research or online auctions.

- Understanding of sports-card values, player demand and different card releases.



**Essential Skills:**



- Strong research and analytical abilities.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Good written English and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions.

- Confidence working with spreadsheets and online research tools.

- Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment.

- Honest, organised and willing to learn.



**Previous sports-card experience is highly desirable but not essential.** We are open to training candidates who demonstrate excellent research skills, initiative and have a genuine interest in the sports listed above.



## Salary, Bonuses & Career Progression



We aim to offer a competitive salary of **up to AUD $8 per hour, plus performance-based bonuses**.



The starting hourly rate will be negotiated based on your existing experience, skills and sports-card knowledge.



We also offer:



- Performance-based bonuses for consistently achieving sourcing targets and delivering strong results.

- Regular salary and performance reviews, with opportunities for pay increases as your skills develop.

- Training and support to help you become a highly effective sourcing specialist.

- Opportunities to take on greater responsibility as the business grows.

- Stable, long-term work with an Australian business.



We believe in rewarding employees who demonstrate accuracy, reliability, initiative and a strong commitment to achieving results.



## Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position, approximately 40 hours per week.



Working hours can be discussed with the successful candidate. Some flexibility may be required to monitor and bid on auctions ending at different times.



## How to Apply



Please submit an application that includes the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant work experience.

2. Your experience with sports cards, including which sports, brands or products you are familiar with.

3. Any previous experience with eBay auctions, product sourcing or online research.

4. Which tools or websites you have used to research sports-card market values.

5. Your expected hourly salary in AUD.

6. Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid practical sourcing assessment to demonstrate their research abilities and understanding of sports-card valuations.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship with our business and become an important part of our sourcing operations.



**We look forward to receiving your application!**

title: Cybersecurity Engineer (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want a dedicated specialist who works on security full-time, finds issues before our clients do, and helps our developers ship safely.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Handle security breach response and support our vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security finds issues, checks the fixes, and flags releases that aren't safe to go live.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 2 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in TypeScript/React/Next, Python or Postgres

- Azure security experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You work independently and follow through without being chased

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- Knowledge of the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Experience with Supabase

- Can read code 

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Real impact: your findings directly shape what we ship

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: room to grow into a lead role as our security work grows

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into cybersecurity.

2. A finding you are proud of: Walk us through a real vulnerability you found. How did you find it, what was the impact, and how did you get it fixed? Leave out anything confidential.

3. Raising a security issue: Tell us about a time you found a serious issue close to a release or deadline. How did you explain it to the team, and what happened next?

4. Securing AI: An AI assistant at a client can read their documents and use tools through MCP. What are the main risks, including which model providers may see client data, and what would you check first?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application

Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, bug bounty profile, GitHub, LinkedIn, or an anonymized finding report you wrote



 subject: "Cybersecurity Engineer Application - [Your Name]"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



WHO SHOULD APPLY

Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like hands-on security work across applications, cloud and AI

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and the new security risks it brings



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Don't have hands-on application security or pentesting experience



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 and 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Creator Coach for a photo album brand (manage our ambassador creators)
description:
We make personalized photo albums. Our growth comes from creators: ambassadors who share Souvence on Instagram and TikTok.



We have the creators. We need the person who makes them great.



What you'll do

- Recruit and onboard new creators until their first post.

- Review their videos before they post, and tell them how to make them better.

- Keep 50 creators posting every week. Follow up with the ones who go quiet.

- Track who's active, what performs, and report it every Monday.



You're our person if

- You have managed creators, ambassadors or influencers for a brand or an agency (1 year minimum).

- You can look at a video and say exactly why it will work or not.

- You work in English every day.

- You're organized: you'd rather have a tracker than a memory.



Full-time, fully remote, long-term.

title: TikTok Shop Creator Manager
description:
Do you already manage TikTok Shop affiliates or creators for a brand or an agency? This role is for you.



We're Souvence, a photo album brand selling in Europe. We run a creator program: creators post about our albums on TikTok and Instagram every week.



Your job: keep that community alive and growing.



Every week you will

- Find and onboard new creators.

- Give clear feedback on their content before it goes live.

- Re-activate creators who stopped posting.

- Know your numbers: who posted, what worked, what didn't.

- 1+ year managing TikTok Shop affiliates, creators or ambassadors.

title: Youtube Senior Video Editor
description:
Hey Editors! It’s Time to Level Up. Ready to Take Your Editing Career Further?



We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

20 days of paid time off annually.

12 additional holidays per year.

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)



If you’re ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in shaping the future of YouTube, please apply using the link below.

We only accept applications submitted through this form:
