title: DTC Website Performance and CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Website Performance & CRO Manager to own conversion performance across our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) client portfolio.



In this role, you will be responsible for improving website conversion rates, optimizing user experience, maintaining website performance standards, and driving measurable revenue growth for Shopify-based brands. You will proactively identify opportunities, develop optimization strategies, execute experiments, and translate data into actionable business decisions.



This is not a task-execution role. We are looking for someone who can independently identify what needs to be optimized, prioritize initiatives based on business impact, and connect every website improvement to measurable performance outcomes.



Key Responsibilities:

CRO & Conversion Ownership

- Conduct comprehensive CRO audits to identify user friction, conversion barriers, and revenue opportunities

- Develop, prioritize, and execute A/B tests across homepages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, landing pages, and checkout experiences

- Analyze customer behavior using heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analysis, and behavioral analytics tools

- Create hypotheses based on quantitative and qualitative data and validate them through structured experimentation

- Deliver clear optimization recommendations supported by data and expected business impact

- Provide wireframes, mockups, and implementation guidance to designers and developers



Website Performance Management

- Monitor and improve website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall site performance across all assigned client accounts

- Ensure websites meet performance benchmarks while maintaining a seamless user experience

- Coordinate and oversee quality assurance (QA) processes before launches, deployments, and website updates

- Identify technical issues and performance risks within one business day of detection

- Escalate unresolved blockers promptly to maintain project momentum and client performance goals



Analytics & Reporting

- Own GA4 implementation, tracking accuracy, and reporting across client websites

- Analyze Shopify and GA4 data to identify opportunities, trends, and performance gaps

- Establish performance baselines for new client accounts within 30 days of onboarding

- Deliver monthly performance reports that connect optimization initiatives to conversion rate, average order value (AOV), and revenue impact

- Provide actionable insights rather than simply reporting metrics



Client Portfolio Support

- Manage multiple website optimization initiatives across a portfolio of DTC clients

- Develop and maintain rolling 30/60/90-day optimization roadmaps for each account

- Collaborate with DTC Brand Managers to ensure website initiatives support broader business objectives

- Support client-facing teams with performance insights, recommendations, and deliverables



Process Improvement & Documentation

- Create and maintain SOPs for all CRO, analytics, QA, and website performance processes

- Continuously improve workflows to increase efficiency, scalability, and quality

- Stay current with CRO, UX, Shopify, analytics, and e-commerce best practices



Key Performance Indicators:

- Conversion rate improvement: measurable CVR lift per client site tracked month over month. Baseline established within 30 days of onboarding

- A/B test velocity: minimum 2 active tests per client site at all times. Every test has a documented hypothesis, success metric, and post-test outcome

- Google Page Speed score: ≥80 on mobile and desktop across all active client sites, maintained continuously

- Revenue-attributed reporting: at least 1 documented report per client per month connecting site changes to CVR, AOV, or revenue movement

- Project delivery rate: ≥90% of website projects delivered on time with completed QA documentation. Zero launches without sign-off



Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in CRO, website performance, UX optimization, or DTC e-commerce

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify, including product pages, themes, site structure, and conversion optimization

- Advanced proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Experience using Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar behavioral analytics platforms

- Demonstrated success running A/B tests and translating results into measurable business outcomes

- Strong understanding of conversion funnels, user behavior, and customer journey optimization

- Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

- Agency experience or experience supporting multiple brands is highly preferred



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement



Ready to take your skills to the next level? If this role feels like the right fit for you, don’t wait—apply today and join a team where your impact truly matters.

title: DIY Fashion Brand Assistant (sewing and Adobe skills)
description:
Hi! I'm Isabelle and I have a DIY fashion brand = I sell clothing styles in the shape of PDF sewing patterns, for creative people who want to sew their own clothes. 



When people buy my products, they get:

1) a PDF sewing pattern.

2) a PDF instructions file with fabric recommendations, fabric yardage, body measurements... and sewing instructions which consist in text + sketches (20 pages).

3) a PDF file with the fabric yardage and cutting layouts (4 pages).

4) a video tutorial (basically, the instructions, but this time, in video).



I'm looking for someone who could make the steps 2, 3, 4. 



Required skills:

- you must know how to sew, about fabrics... and the sewing vocabulary in English. Topstitching, understitching, overlocker, right/wrong side of the fabric, interfacing... 

- Premiere Pro to make the video tutorial

- Illustrator to create the instructions sketches

- InDesign to create the PDF instructions and fabric layout files (using my template).

- you must be smart and have a great attention to details.



Estimated time needed: eventually (=after an adaptation/learning period), I could send 1-2 projects per month. One project would take 4-5 days.



I'm looking for someone to collaborate with on the long run. There would necessarily be a "training period" or a couple of training exercices, where you'd be adjusting to the tasks, there would be a lot of feedback.

title: Product & Packaging Designer
description:
Type: Gig



TO APPLY (FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS TO BE CONSIDERED):

     1. Subject line: Product and Packaging Designer

     2. A short hello and your proposed rate in USD

     3. A link to your portfolio. Show us range, but more importantly, show us taste.

     4. A live Figma, illustrator or relevant working file from a real project you've shipped. View-only access is fine. Please include this in your application to be considered.



Share two products, packaging, or 3D designs you're particularly proud of. What informed the form, materials, typography, composition, or visual direction?



What we need

• Hands-on experience in consumer product design, packaging design, 3D visualization, or a combination of these.

• A portfolio that demonstrates taste, strong visual judgment, and a clear point of view.

• An understanding of how materials, proportions, finishes, colors, and details influence how a product is perceived.

• Strong design fundamentals, including typography, layout, spacing, composition, and visual hierarchy.

• The ability to translate a brand's identity into physical products and packaging that feel cohesive, considered, and distinctive.

• Strong 3D modeling, rendering, or visualization skills. We want to see how you bring a product to life before it exists physically.

• An understanding that good design goes beyond aesthetics. Every decision should have intention behind it, from the shape of a container to the way information appears on a label.

• Strong communication skills. We're a small team, and reliability, responsiveness, and clear communication are non-negotiable.

Someone who genuinely cares about the craft and notices the details others miss.



What you'll work on

• Consumer product concepts and visual development

• Product packaging, labels, and structural design

• 3D product modeling, rendering, and visualization

• Packaging materials, finishes, colors, and form exploration

• Product mockups and photorealistic renders for digital use

• Product-related creative assets for websites, landing pages, and marketing campaigns

• Visual concepts for new products and product extensions

• Brand consistency across physical products, packaging, and digital touchpoints

• Depending on your strengths, there may also be opportunities to contribute to broader graphic design work, including digital ads, website graphics, social media assets, and other brand creative.



Bonus

- Experience with DTC, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, skincare, wellness, or premium consumer brands.

- Proficiency in tools such as Blender or other relevant 3D software.

- Experience with packaging production, dielines, print specifications, and preparing files for manufacturing.

- Strong Figma fluency, particularly with components, variants, auto layout, and design systems.

- A strong graphic design background, especially in typography, art direction, and visual - storytelling.

- Confidence using AI tools to explore concepts, develop visual directions, and improve creative workflows.



Working with us

[ ] Work from anywhere that inspires you

[ ] Working hours: US Pacific time

[ ] Paid Philippine holidays

[ ] Compensation that reflects what this role is worth

[ ] A small, considered team building something beautiful



About us



We're Cabana.



A modern wellness brand where the science is sharp, the experience is elevated, and the design has to keep up. Skin. Sleep. Hormones. Weight. Energy.



We're building a brand that brings modern medicine and elevated lifestyle together. Every touchpoint matters, from the products themselves to the packaging they arrive in and the visuals that introduce them to the world. See us at 
.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes things look good. We're looking for a designer who understands how form, material, proportion, and visual language shape perception. Someone with strong fundamentals, excellent creative instincts, and the ability to turn an idea into something that feels tangible, desirable, and unmistakably part of the brand.
